examples.text: Exercise is good for your mental health.

senses.definition: an important job or journey, especially one with a special purpose

examples.text: The space mission will study the planet Mars.

translations.zh: 这次太空任务将研究火星。

senses.definition: bad or harmful; also thinking only about the bad side of things

examples.text: Too much screen time can have a negative effect on sleep.

translations.zh: 看屏幕太久会对睡眠产生负面影响。

senses.definition: a time when something happens, or a special event

examples.text: A birthday is a special occasion.

translations.zh: 生日是一个特殊的日子。

senses.definition: normal; not special or different

examples.text: It was just an ordinary day at school.

translations.zh: 那只是学校里普普通通的一天。

senses.definition: a basic rule or belief that guides how you act or how something works

examples.text: Honesty is one of her strongest principles.

translations.zh: 诚实是她最坚守的原则之一。

senses.usageNote: Don't confuse 'principle' (a rule or belief) with 'principal' (the head of a school, or main).

senses.definition: the way things really are, not how you imagine them

examples.text: The trip looked easy, but in reality it was very hard.

translations.zh: 这趟旅行看起来很轻松，但实际上非常辛苦。

senses.definition: the act of politely asking for something

examples.text: The library agreed to our request for more books.

translations.zh: 图书馆同意了我们增加藏书的请求。

senses.usageNote: As a verb, 'request' is formal and takes no 'for': 'request help', not 'request for help'. As a noun, use 'a request for'.

senses.definition: the size or level of something

examples.text: The project was done on a large scale.

translations.zh: 这个项目是大规模进行的。

senses.definition: a machine for weighing things

examples.text: Put the apples on the scales.

senses.definition: a period of time spent doing a particular activity

examples.text: The swimming session lasts one hour.

senses.definition: a group of animals or plants of the same type

examples.text: There are many species of birds in this forest.

translations.zh: 这片森林里有很多种鸟。

senses.usageNote: 'Species' is the same in singular and plural: 'one species', 'ten species'.

senses.definition: a positive attitude or feeling shared by a group

examples.text: The team showed great spirit even when they were losing.

translations.zh: 即使落后，这支队伍也表现出了顽强的精神。

senses.usageNote: 'In high spirits' means happy and excited.

senses.definition: to continue to live or exist, especially after a difficult time

examples.text: Camels can survive for days without water.

translations.zh: 骆驼可以好几天不喝水也能生存。

senses.definition: a visit to a place to look around it, or a journey visiting several places

examples.text: We went on a tour of the museum.

senses.definition: a custom or belief that has existed for a long time

examples.text: Eating mooncakes is a Mid-Autumn tradition.

translations.zh: 吃月饼是中秋节的传统。

senses.definition: having the usual qualities of a particular type of person or thing

examples.text: This is a typical English breakfast.

translations.zh: 这是一顿典型的英式早餐。

senses.usageNote: Use 'typical of': 'It's typical of him to be late.'

senses.definition: not able to do something

examples.text: I was unable to finish my homework last night.

senses.usageNote: Use 'unable to do something'. It is more formal than 'can't'.

senses.definition: to try very hard to do something difficult

examples.text: I'm struggling with the pronunciation.

senses.usageNote: 'Struggle with' a difficulty; 'struggle to do' something.

senses.definition: to give something, such as money, time or ideas, to help achieve something

examples.text: Several factors contributed to the delay.

senses.usageNote: 'Contribute to something'.

senses.definition: something that helps you or makes you more likely to succeed

examples.text: One advantage of living here is the quiet streets.

translations.zh: 住在这里的一个好处是街道安静。

senses.usageNote: 'Take advantage of' means to use a chance well: 'Take advantage of the sunny weather.'

senses.definition: an event or situation, or matters that concern someone

examples.text: The party was a very noisy affair.

senses.definition: help, especially money, food or supplies for people in need

examples.text: The charity sent aid to the flooded towns.

translations.zh: 慈善机构向受洪灾的城镇送去了援助。

senses.usageNote: 'First aid' is simple medical help given before a doctor comes.

senses.definition: another thing you can choose instead

translations.zh: 替代选择；可供选择的事物

examples.text: Is there a healthy alternative to chips?

translations.zh: 有没有比薯条更健康的替代品？

senses.definition: according to what you have heard, though you are not sure

examples.text: Apparently, the new shop opens next week.

senses.definition: the line that divides two countries or areas

examples.text: We crossed the border into France.

translations.zh: 我们越过边境进入了法国。

senses.definition: the largest amount that something can hold

examples.text: The stadium has a capacity of 40,000 people.

translations.zh: 这座体育场能容纳四万人。

senses.definition: a substance made by or used in chemistry

examples.text: Keep cleaning chemicals away from children.

translations.zh: 清洁用化学品要远离儿童。

senses.definition: the land next to the sea

examples.text: We drove along the coast to the next town.

translations.zh: 我们沿着海岸开车去了下一个镇。

senses.definition: a link between two things or people

examples.text: The internet connection here is very slow.

senses.definition: a result of something, often a bad one

examples.text: Missing the bus had one consequence: I was late.

translations.zh: 没赶上公交车的后果是我迟到了。

senses.definition: the people who work on a ship or plane, or a team working together

translations.zh: 全体船员；机组人员；工作组

examples.text: The crew welcomed us on board the plane.

translations.zh: 机组人员欢迎我们登机。

senses.definition: without any doubt; certainly

examples.text: I will definitely come to your birthday party.

translations.zh: 我一定会来参加你的生日聚会。

senses.usageNote: A very common spelling mistake is 'definately'. Remember: defin-ITE-ly.

senses.definition: to say that something is not true

examples.text: He denied taking the money.

senses.usageNote: Takes a gerund: 'deny taking', not 'deny to take'.

senses.definition: words that say what someone or something is like

examples.text: Write a short description of your bedroom.

translations.zh: 写一段关于你卧室的简短描述。

senses.definition: a machine or tool made for a special purpose

examples.text: Please turn off all electronic devices during the film.

translations.zh: 电影放映期间请关闭所有电子设备。

senses.usageNote: 'Device' (noun, /s/ sound) is different from 'devise' (verb, /z/ sound, to plan something).

senses.definition: to separate something into parts or groups

examples.text: The teacher divided the class into four groups.

translations.zh: 老师把全班分成了四组。

senses.usageNote: Say 'divide into', not 'divide to'. In maths: 'Ten divided by two is five.'

senses.definition: a sudden dangerous situation that needs quick action

examples.text: In an emergency, call this number.

translations.zh: 遇到紧急情况，请拨打这个号码。

senses.definition: the basic idea or part that everything else is built on

examples.text: Good reading skills are the foundation of learning.

translations.zh: 良好的阅读能力是学习的基础。

senses.definition: completely

examples.text: Make sure the phone is fully charged.

senses.definition: to come together in a group, or to collect things

examples.text: People gathered in the square to watch the fireworks.

translations.zh: 人们聚集在广场上看烟花。

senses.definition: money given by an organisation for a special purpose, such as study

examples.text: She got a grant to study music.

translations.zh: 她获得了一笔学音乐的助学金。

senses.usageNote: 'Take something for granted' means expect it without being thankful.

senses.definition: a person who invites guests; a person who presents a TV show

examples.text: Our host showed us around her new flat.

translations.zh: 女主人带我们参观了她的新公寓。

senses.definition: to organise an event and welcome the people who come

examples.text: Our school will host the chess tournament.

translations.zh: 我们学校将主办这次国际象棋比赛。

senses.definition: an agreement where you pay a company and it pays you if something bad happens

examples.text: Don't forget to buy travel insurance before the trip.

translations.zh: 别忘了在出行前买旅游保险。

senses.usageNote: 'Insurance' is uncountable: say 'some insurance' or 'an insurance policy', not 'an insurance'.

senses.definition: how long something is from one end to the other, or how long it lasts

examples.text: The length of the pool is 25 metres.

senses.definition: mostly; more than anything else

examples.text: The class is mainly made up of girls.

senses.definition: a large amount of something without a clear shape; a large number

examples.text: There was a mass of people at the station.

senses.definition: something wrapped in paper or put in a box to be sent or carried

examples.text: A package arrived for you this morning.

translations.zh: 今天早上有你的一个包裹。

senses.definition: something that might happen or be true

examples.text: There's a possibility of snow tomorrow.

senses.definition: a part of a whole, or the relationship between the size of two things

examples.text: A large proportion of the class wear glasses.

translations.zh: 班里很大一部分人戴眼镜。

senses.definition: a plan or idea that is suggested for people to consider

examples.text: The council accepted our proposal for a new playground.

translations.zh: 市议会接受了我们建新游乐场的提议。

senses.definition: to suggest a plan or idea

examples.text: I propose that we meet again next Friday.

translations.zh: 我提议我们下周五再见面。

senses.definition: what you say, do or feel because of something that happens

examples.text: Her first reaction was to laugh.

senses.definition: to send back light, heat or sound from a surface

examples.text: The mountains were reflected in the lake.

senses.definition: to think carefully about something

examples.text: Take some time to reflect on what you have learned.

translations.zh: 花点时间反思一下你学到的东西。

senses.definition: a small amount of something that shows what the rest is like

examples.text: The shop was giving out free samples of cheese.

translations.zh: 商店正在免费派发奶酪试吃品。

senses.definition: a period of work time in a place where people work at different times

examples.text: My mum works the night shift at the hospital.

senses.definition: to move or change a little

examples.text: He shifted his chair closer to the window.

translations.zh: 他把椅子挪得离窗户更近些。

senses.definition: a little

examples.text: This shirt is slightly too big for me.

translations.zh: 这件衬衫我穿稍微大了点。

senses.definition: the situation or position of someone or something at a particular time

examples.text: You can check the status of your order online.

translations.zh: 你可以在网上查看订单状态。

senses.definition: to achieve something that you tried to do

examples.text: She succeeded in passing her driving test.

translations.zh: 她成功通过了驾照考试。

senses.usageNote: Say 'succeed in doing something', not 'succeed to do something'.

senses.definition: a set of questions you ask many people to find out their opinions

examples.text: We did a survey of students' favourite sports.

translations.zh: 我们就学生最喜欢的运动做了一项调查。

senses.definition: being the only one of its kind; very special

examples.text: Every snowflake is unique.

translations.zh: 每一片雪花都是独一无二的。

senses.definition: different from

examples.text: Unlike her sister, she loves sport.

translations.zh: 和她姐姐不同，她热爱运动。

senses.definition: a machine such as a car, bus or lorry that carries people or things

examples.text: No vehicles are allowed in the park.

senses.definition: going through a place, or using a particular method

examples.text: We flew to London via Dubai.

senses.definition: the ability to see

examples.text: Cats have good vision in the dark.

senses.definition: an idea or picture in your mind of what the future could be like

examples.text: She has a clear vision for the club.

translations.zh: 她对这个俱乐部有清晰的愿景。

senses.definition: the time of life when you are young

examples.text: My grandfather played football in his youth.

translations.zh: 我爷爷年轻时踢过足球。

senses.definition: young people as a group

examples.text: The town built a new youth centre.

translations.zh: 这个镇新建了一个青少年活动中心。

senses.definition: sure of yourself or of a result

examples.text: I'm confident we'll finish on time.

translations.zh: 我有信心我们能按时完成。

senses.usageNote: Do not confuse with 'confidant', a person you trust with secrets.

senses.definition: to have enough money or time for something

examples.text: We can't afford a new car this year.

senses.usageNote: Almost always with 'can', 'could' or a negative.

senses.definition: happening once every year

examples.text: The annual sports day is in June.

translations.zh: 一年一度的运动会在六月举行。

senses.definition: to be owned by someone, or to be in the right place

examples.text: Does this pencil case belong to you?

senses.usageNote: Say 'It belongs to me', not 'It is belong to me'. 'Belong' is not used in the continuous form.

senses.definition: the usual weather in a place over a long time

examples.text: The south of Spain has a warm climate.

senses.usageNote: 'Weather' is what happens day to day; 'climate' is the general pattern over years.

senses.definition: an order to do something

examples.text: The dog obeys simple commands like 'sit'.

translations.zh: 这条狗会听从“坐下”之类的简单指令。

senses.definition: a promise to do something, or being willing to give time and effort

examples.text: Learning an instrument takes a lot of commitment.

translations.zh: 学一门乐器需要大量投入。

senses.definition: to say exactly what a word or idea means

examples.text: Can you define the word 'habitat'?

translations.zh: 你能给“栖息地”这个词下定义吗？

senses.definition: to become bigger, or to make something bigger

examples.text: The small café has expanded into a big restaurant.

translations.zh: 那家小咖啡馆已经扩展成一家大餐厅。

senses.definition: to travel around a place to learn about it

examples.text: We spent the afternoon exploring the old town.

translations.zh: 我们花了一下午游览老城。

senses.definition: how large, important or serious something is

examples.text: To some extent, I agree with you.

translations.zh: 在某种程度上，我同意你的看法。

senses.definition: an empty space between two things; a difference

examples.text: The cat squeezed through a gap in the fence.

translations.zh: 猫从篱笆的缝隙中挤了过去。

senses.usageNote: 'Fill in the gaps' is the usual instruction for a gap-fill exercise.

senses.definition: a person whose job is to protect a place or people

examples.text: A guard stood at the gate of the museum.

translations.zh: 一名警卫站在博物馆门口。

senses.definition: to watch and protect someone or something

examples.text: The dog guards the farm at night.

senses.definition: almost not; only a very small amount

examples.text: I could hardly hear the teacher because of the noise.

translations.zh: 太吵了，我几乎听不见老师说话。

senses.usageNote: 'Hardly' does not mean 'hard'. 'He works hard' (a lot) vs 'He hardly works' (almost not at all). Don't add 'not' after 'hardly'.

senses.definition: happening now or very soon, without waiting

examples.text: The new rule will have an immediate effect.

translations.zh: 这条新规定将立即生效。

senses.definition: mostly; mainly

examples.text: The town's success is largely due to tourism.

translations.zh: 这个小镇的成功主要归功于旅游业。

senses.definition: a person whose job is to give advice about the law

examples.text: Her mother works as a lawyer in the city.

senses.definition: a long story in a book about imaginary people and events

examples.text: I'm reading a novel about a girl who travels in time.

translations.zh: 我在读一本关于一个穿越时空的女孩的小说。

senses.usageNote: A 'novel' is always fiction. A true story about someone's life is a 'biography'.

senses.definition: perhaps; also used to make a request more polite

translations.zh: 可能；也许；（用于客气请求）

examples.text: Could you possibly help me with this bag?

translations.zh: 您能帮我拿一下这个包吗？

senses.definition: right, suitable or real

examples.text: You need proper shoes for walking in the hills.

translations.zh: 在山里走路你需要一双合适的鞋。

senses.definition: having a higher position or more experience than others

examples.text: She is a senior engineer at the company.

translations.zh: 她是这家公司的高级工程师。

senses.definition: the ability to see

examples.text: My grandpa's sight is getting worse.

translations.zh: 我爷爷的视力越来越差了。

senses.definition: something you see, especially something interesting

examples.text: We saw all the famous sights of Beijing.

translations.zh: 我们游览了北京所有的著名景点。

senses.definition: how loud a sound is

examples.text: Could you turn the volume down a little?

translations.zh: 你能把音量调小一点吗？

senses.definition: the amount of space something fills, or the amount of something

examples.text: The volume of traffic is heavy in the morning.

senses.definition: to tell someone about a possible danger or problem

examples.text: Mum warned us not to swim too far out.

translations.zh: 妈妈提醒我们不要游得太远。

senses.usageNote: Patterns: 'warn someone about something' and 'warn someone (not) to do something'.

senses.definition: something that tells you about possible danger

examples.text: There's a storm warning for tomorrow.

senses.definition: used to compare two different facts

examples.text: I love maths, whereas my brother prefers art.

translations.zh: 我喜欢数学，而我哥哥更喜欢美术。

senses.definition: happy to do something if it is needed

examples.text: Are you willing to help with the school fair?

translations.zh: 你愿意帮忙办学校义卖会吗？

senses.definition: completely; used to make a word stronger or to agree strongly

examples.text: The view from the top was absolutely amazing.

translations.zh: 从顶上看到的景色真是太美了。

examples.text: "Can I help?" "Absolutely!"

senses.usageNote: Use 'absolutely' with strong adjectives like 'amazing' or 'freezing', not with 'very' words such as 'good' or 'cold'.

senses.definition: to be attractive or interesting to someone

examples.text: Camping doesn't really appeal to me.

translations.zh: 露营对我没什么吸引力。

senses.definition: a serious request for help, money or information

examples.text: The zoo made an appeal for donations.

translations.zh: 动物园发出了捐款呼吁。

senses.definition: short, lasting only a little time or using few words

examples.text: She gave a brief speech at the start.

translations.zh: 她在开场时做了简短的讲话。

senses.definition: a line of metal rings joined together

examples.text: The chain came off my bike.

senses.definition: a group of shops or hotels owned by one company

examples.text: It's part of a chain of coffee shops.

translations.zh: 它是一家连锁咖啡店的分店。

senses.definition: to join or mix two or more things together

examples.text: Combine the flour and sugar in a bowl.

translations.zh: 把面粉和糖放在碗里混合。

senses.definition: the most important or central part of something; also, the middle of an apple

examples.text: Reading is at the core of learning.

senses.definition: a discussion in which people give different opinions about a subject

examples.text: Our class had a debate about school uniforms.

translations.zh: 我们班就校服问题进行了一场辩论。

senses.definition: to go where you cannot see it; to stop existing

examples.text: The sun disappeared behind the clouds.

senses.definition: in or to another place

examples.text: This café is full, so let's go elsewhere.

translations.zh: 这家咖啡馆满了，我们去别处吧。

senses.definition: to come out from somewhere and be seen

examples.text: A little rabbit emerged from its hole.

translations.zh: 一只小兔子从洞里钻了出来。

senses.definition: relating to feelings; showing strong feelings

examples.text: Everyone got emotional at the end of the film.

translations.zh: 电影结尾时大家都很动情。

senses.definition: to get away from a place where you are kept or from danger

examples.text: Our hamster escaped from its cage last night.

translations.zh: 我们的仓鼠昨晚从笼子里逃了出去。

senses.definition: the state of being real or present

examples.text: This is the oldest tree in existence.

senses.definition: money you pay for a service, lesson or entry

examples.text: The entry fee for the museum is five pounds.

translations.zh: 这家博物馆的门票是五英镑。

senses.definition: the management of money

examples.text: My aunt works in finance.

translations.zh: 我姑姑在金融行业工作。

senses.definition: to produce something such as energy or ideas

examples.text: Wind turbines generate electricity.

senses.definition: a mark given for school work or an exam

examples.text: She got a top grade in her piano exam.

translations.zh: 她钢琴考试得了最高等级。

senses.definition: very large and impressive

examples.text: The hotel has a grand staircase.

translations.zh: 这家酒店有一座气派的楼梯。

senses.definition: how tall or high someone or something is

examples.text: What is the height of that tower?

senses.usageNote: Pronounced /haɪt/, with no 'th' sound at the end (unlike 'length' and 'width').

senses.definition: to pay no attention to someone or something

examples.text: She ignored the noise and kept reading.

translations.zh: 她不理会噪音，继续看书。

senses.usageNote: 'Ignore' means you choose not to notice something. If you simply do not know something, say 'I don't know', not 'I ignore it'.

senses.definition: fair treatment of people

examples.text: Everyone should be treated with justice and respect.

translations.zh: 每个人都应该得到公正和尊重的对待。

senses.definition: the position or ability of being in charge of a group

examples.text: The captain showed great leadership during the match.

translations.zh: 队长在比赛中表现出了出色的领导能力。

senses.definition: novels, poems and plays, especially ones thought to be very good

examples.text: She is studying English literature at university.

translations.zh: 她在大学学习英国文学。

senses.definition: the way something is done or the way a person behaves

examples.text: She spoke in a calm and friendly manner.

translations.zh: 她以平静友好的态度说话。

senses.usageNote: The plural 'manners' means polite behaviour: 'good manners'.

senses.definition: small and not very important or serious

examples.text: There are a few minor mistakes in your essay.

translations.zh: 你的文章里有几个小错误。

senses.definition: to watch someone or something carefully

examples.text: We observed the birds through our binoculars.

translations.zh: 我们用双筒望远镜观察鸟儿。

senses.definition: to help something succeed or become popular; also to give someone a higher job

examples.text: The band is on tour to promote their new album.

translations.zh: 乐队正在巡演宣传他们的新专辑。

senses.definition: a strong statement or action that shows you disagree with something

examples.text: The students wrote a letter of protest about the school dinners.

translations.zh: 学生们写了一封信抗议学校的午餐。

senses.definition: to help someone remember something

examples.text: Please remind me to call Grandma tonight.

translations.zh: 请提醒我今晚给奶奶打电话。

senses.usageNote: Chinese speakers often say 'remember me to...' by mistake. Use 'remind someone to do something' or 'remind someone of something'.

senses.definition: a plan that lists when things will happen

examples.text: I have a busy schedule this week.

senses.usageNote: 'On schedule' means on time; 'behind schedule' means late. British speakers often say /ˈʃedjuːl/, Americans /ˈskedʒuːl/.

senses.definition: a sound, action or light that gives information or a message

examples.text: There's no phone signal in the mountains.

senses.definition: to change from one thing to another

examples.text: Let's switch to a different topic.

senses.usageNote: 'Switch on' and 'switch off' are used for lights and machines, like 'turn on/off'.

senses.definition: a small button you press to turn electricity on or off

examples.text: The light switch is by the door.

senses.definition: a general change or development in a particular direction

examples.text: There is a trend towards healthier eating.

senses.definition: to plan or organise something

examples.text: We arranged to meet at the station.

senses.definition: to make someone want to come to or be interested in something

examples.text: The festival attracts thousands of visitors.

translations.zh: 这个节日吸引了成千上万的游客。

senses.definition: a part of a tree that grows out from the main stem

examples.text: A bird was sitting on a branch.

senses.definition: one of the shops or offices of a large company

examples.text: The bank has a branch in our town.

translations.zh: 这家银行在我们镇上有一个分行。

senses.definition: two or more things mixed or used together

examples.text: Blue and yellow is a nice colour combination.

translations.zh: 蓝色和黄色是很好看的颜色搭配。

senses.definition: large in size or amount

examples.text: The project took a considerable amount of time.

translations.zh: 这个项目花了相当多的时间。

senses.usageNote: Don't confuse 'considerable' (large) with 'considerate' (kind and thoughtful).

senses.definition: to protect someone or something, or to speak in support of them

examples.text: He always defends his little sister.

senses.definition: using computer technology, or showing information as numbers

examples.text: My grandad bought a new digital camera.

translations.zh: 我爷爷买了一台新的数码相机。

senses.definition: working by electricity

examples.text: My uncle drives an electric car.

senses.definition: often

examples.text: He frequently visits his grandparents.

translations.zh: 他经常去看望爷爷奶奶。

senses.definition: harm done to a person's body, for example in an accident

examples.text: She couldn't run the race because of a leg injury.

translations.zh: 她因为腿伤没法参加赛跑。

senses.definition: the newest or most recent

examples.text: Have you heard their latest song?

translations.zh: 你听过他们的最新歌曲吗？

senses.definition: usually; in the usual way

examples.text: I normally get up at seven o'clock.

senses.definition: useful and sensible, or connected with doing things rather than ideas

examples.text: Trainers are more practical than high heels for walking.

translations.zh: 走路时运动鞋比高跟鞋更实用。

senses.definition: to remember something

examples.text: I can't recall where I put my keys.

translations.zh: 我想不起来把钥匙放哪儿了。

senses.definition: to say that someone or something is good and suggest that others try it

examples.text: Can you recommend a good book for my son?

translations.zh: 你能给我儿子推荐一本好书吗？

senses.usageNote: Say 'recommend that he goes' or 'recommend going', not 'recommend him to go'. Spelling: one 'c', double 'm'.

senses.definition: to think that something is probably true

examples.text: I suspect it will rain later.

senses.usageNote: 'Suspect that...' means you think something IS true; 'doubt that...' means you think it is NOT true.

senses.definition: very small

examples.text: The kitten was tiny when we got it.

translations.zh: 我们刚领养这只小猫时它非常小。

senses.definition: difficult to do or deal with

examples.text: It was a tough decision.

senses.definition: strong and not easily hurt or broken

examples.text: You need tough boots for mountain walking.

translations.zh: 山地徒步需要结实的靴子。

senses.definition: to move someone or something from one place to another

examples.text: I transferred the photos from my phone to my laptop.

translations.zh: 我把照片从手机传到了笔记本电脑上。

senses.usageNote: The verb has stress on the second syllable (/trænsˈfɜː/); the noun on the first (/ˈtrænsfɜː/).

senses.definition: ways of carrying people or goods from one place to another

examples.text: The city has good public transport.

translations.zh: 这座城市的公共交通很好。

senses.usageNote: British English says 'transport'; American English often says 'transportation'. It is uncountable.

senses.definition: probably not going to happen

examples.text: It's unlikely to snow in October.

senses.usageNote: 'Unlikely' is an adjective, not an adverb: 'He is unlikely to come', not 'He unlikely comes'.

senses.definition: to be different in different situations

examples.text: Prices vary from shop to shop.

senses.definition: living, not dead

examples.text: Is this plant still alive?

senses.usageNote: Use 'alive' after a verb ('The fish is alive') and 'live' /laɪv/ before a noun ('a live fish').

senses.definition: to think something is good, or to officially agree to it

examples.text: The council approved the plan for a new park.

translations.zh: 议会批准了新建公园的计划。

senses.usageNote: When you mean 'think it is good', use 'approve of': 'My parents don't approve of late nights.'

senses.definition: a plan or preparation for something

examples.text: Have you made arrangements for the party?

translations.zh: 你为聚会做好安排了吗？

senses.definition: the act of judging how good or bad something is

examples.text: We have a maths assessment on Friday.

translations.zh: 我们周五有一次数学测评。

senses.definition: to say that someone caused something bad

examples.text: Don't blame me for the mess!

translations.zh: 别把弄乱的事怪到我头上！

senses.usageNote: Two patterns: 'blame someone for something' and 'blame something on someone'.

senses.definition: wide; also, including many different things

examples.text: The library has a broad range of books.

translations.zh: 这个图书馆藏书种类广泛。

senses.definition: an organisation that collects money to help people or animals in need

examples.text: We raised money for a children's charity.

translations.zh: 我们为一家儿童慈善机构筹了款。

senses.definition: to join two things together

examples.text: Connect the printer to your laptop.

translations.zh: 把打印机连到你的笔记本电脑上。

senses.definition: the act of making something new, or the thing that is made

examples.text: The chef showed us his latest creation.

translations.zh: 厨师向我们展示了他的最新作品。

senses.definition: money that you owe to someone

examples.text: He worked hard to pay off his debt.

translations.zh: 他努力工作来还清债务。

senses.usageNote: The 'b' is silent. We say 'be in debt' (owe money) and 'get into debt'.

senses.definition: to show clearly how something works or that something is true

examples.text: The teacher demonstrated how to use the microscope.

translations.zh: 老师演示了如何使用显微镜。

senses.definition: a strong feeling such as love, anger or fear

examples.text: It's OK to show your emotions.

translations.zh: 表达自己的情绪是可以的。

senses.definition: a person or company that pays people to work for them

examples.text: The hospital is the largest employer in the town.

translations.zh: 这家医院是镇上最大的雇主。

senses.definition: extremely large

examples.text: The whale was enormous.

senses.definition: completely correct in every detail

examples.text: What is the exact time of the concert?

translations.zh: 音乐会的确切时间是几点？

senses.definition: used to describe people who are in the same situation as you

examples.text: He shared his snacks with his fellow students.

translations.zh: 他和同学们分享了他的零食。

senses.definition: something such as petrol, gas or wood that is burned to make heat or power

examples.text: The car is running out of fuel.

senses.definition: damage or hurt

examples.text: A little rain won't do you any harm.

translations.zh: 下点小雨不会对你有什么伤害。

senses.definition: all the people who live together in one home

examples.text: Everyone in the household helps with cleaning.

translations.zh: 家里每个人都帮忙打扫卫生。

senses.definition: who a person is, or the qualities that make them different from others

examples.text: You need to show proof of your identity at the airport.

translations.zh: 在机场你需要出示身份证明。

senses.definition: happening at the beginning

examples.text: My initial idea was to walk, but it started raining.

translations.zh: 我最初的想法是走路，但后来开始下雨了。

senses.definition: the first letter of a name

examples.text: He wrote his initials on the book.

translations.zh: 他在书上写下了自己名字的首字母。

senses.definition: to plan or want to do something

examples.text: I intend to finish my project this weekend.

translations.zh: 我打算这个周末完成我的项目。

senses.definition: shared by or done by two or more people

examples.text: The poster was a joint project by the whole class.

translations.zh: 这张海报是全班共同完成的项目。

senses.definition: a place in the body where two bones meet, such as the knee

examples.text: Swimming is good for your joints.

senses.definition: money that you borrow and must pay back

examples.text: They got a loan from the bank to buy a house.

translations.zh: 他们从银行贷款买了一套房子。

senses.definition: at the same time, or in the time between two events

examples.text: Dad cooked dinner. Meanwhile, I set the table.

translations.zh: 爸爸做晚饭，与此同时我摆好了餐桌。

senses.definition: a feeling of happiness or enjoyment

examples.text: Reading gives me a lot of pleasure.

translations.zh: 阅读给我带来很多乐趣。

senses.usageNote: 'It's a pleasure' or 'My pleasure' is a polite answer when someone thanks you.

senses.definition: correctly or in a suitable way

examples.text: Make sure the door is closed properly.

senses.definition: to refuse to accept or agree with something

examples.text: The teacher rejected my idea for the project.

translations.zh: 老师否定了我的项目想法。

senses.definition: an official plan for doing something

examples.text: The city started a new scheme to plant more trees.

translations.zh: 这座城市启动了一个多种树的新计划。

senses.definition: to choose something carefully

examples.text: Select a picture for your profile.

translations.zh: 为你的个人资料选一张图片。

senses.definition: to be all around something or someone

examples.text: The house is surrounded by tall trees.

translations.zh: 房子四周环绕着高大的树木。

senses.definition: the way a voice sounds, showing how someone feels

examples.text: I didn't like the tone of his voice.

translations.zh: 我不喜欢他说话的语气。

senses.usageNote: Chinese has four 'tones' (声调); English uses 'tone' more for feelings in the voice.

senses.definition: slowly, over a period of time

examples.text: The intervals gradually get longer.

senses.definition: to have earned something by what you have done

examples.text: After all that work, you deserve a break.

translations.zh: 经过这么多努力，你该休息一下了。

senses.definition: real, not guessed or imagined

examples.text: The actual cost was higher than we expected.

translations.zh: 实际费用比我们预期的高。

senses.definition: the way someone or something looks

examples.text: She changed her appearance with a new haircut.

translations.zh: 她换了新发型，改变了外貌。

senses.definition: to be grateful for something

examples.text: I really appreciate your help.

senses.usageNote: Don't use 'appreciate' with a person as the object for thanks: say 'I appreciate your help', not 'I appreciate you for helping'.

senses.definition: to begin to happen or exist, often a problem

examples.text: Call me if any problems arise.

translations.zh: 如果出现任何问题就给我打电话。

senses.definition: help

examples.text: Please ask the staff if you need any assistance.

translations.zh: 如需帮助，请询问工作人员。

senses.definition: next to

examples.text: Come and sit beside me.

senses.usageNote: 'Beside' means 'next to'; 'besides' means 'in addition to' or 'also'.

senses.definition: to move air out of your mouth, or (of wind) to move

examples.text: The wind blows hard in winter here.
She blew out the candles on her cake.
examples.cloze: She {{blew}} out the candles on her cake.

translations.zh: 她吹灭了蛋糕上的蜡烛。

senses.definition: the air that goes into and out of your body

examples.text: Take a deep breath and relax.

senses.usageNote: 'Breath' /breθ/ is the noun; 'breathe' /briːð/ is the verb.

senses.definition: wanting very much to win or be better than others

examples.text: My brother is very competitive at board games.

translations.zh: 我哥哥玩桌游时特别好胜。

senses.definition: one of the parts that something is made of

examples.text: The factory makes components for bikes.

translations.zh: 这家工厂生产自行车零部件。

senses.definition: to be made of certain parts

examples.text: The team consists of eleven players.

translations.zh: 这支队伍由十一名队员组成。

senses.usageNote: Always 'consist of', and it is not used in the continuous: say 'it consists of', not 'it is consisting of'.

senses.definition: always behaving or happening in the same way

examples.text: Her work has been consistent all year.

translations.zh: 她一整年的表现都很稳定。

senses.definition: happening all the time, or staying the same

examples.text: The constant noise made it hard to sleep.

translations.zh: 持续的噪音让人难以入睡。

senses.definition: a clear difference between two things

examples.text: There is a big contrast between summer and winter here.

translations.zh: 这里夏天和冬天的反差很大。

senses.usageNote: 'In contrast' or 'by contrast' introduces a difference, like 'however'.

senses.definition: comments that say what is wrong with something

examples.text: Try to learn from criticism.

senses.definition: extremely important

examples.text: Sleep is crucial for your health.

senses.definition: to become smaller, weaker or less

examples.text: The number of birds in the area has declined.

translations.zh: 这个地区鸟的数量减少了。

senses.definition: to say politely that you will not accept something

examples.text: She declined the invitation because she was busy.

senses.definition: a strong feeling of wanting something

examples.text: He has a strong desire to travel the world.

senses.definition: relating to the home, or inside one country rather than abroad

examples.text: We took a domestic flight from Shanghai to Chengdu.

translations.zh: 我们从上海坐国内航班去成都。

senses.definition: to pay someone to work for you

examples.text: The bakery employs ten people.

translations.zh: 这家面包店雇了十个人。

senses.definition: a scientific test to find out what happens

examples.text: We did an experiment with ice and salt.

translations.zh: 我们用冰和盐做了一个实验。

senses.usageNote: We 'do' or 'carry out' an experiment.

senses.definition: words that make something clear or give a reason

examples.text: The teacher's explanation was very clear.

senses.usageNote: Note the spelling: 'explain' but 'explanation' (no 'i').

senses.definition: very great in degree; much more than usual

examples.text: Some animals can live in extreme cold.

translations.zh: 有些动物能在极度寒冷中生存。

senses.definition: suitable for serious or official situations

examples.text: Write a formal letter to the head teacher.

translations.zh: 给校长写一封正式的信。

senses.definition: to start a company, school or organisation

examples.text: The zoo was founded over a hundred years ago.

translations.zh: 这家动物园创建于一百多年前。

senses.usageNote: Don't confuse 'found · founded · founded' (start something) with 'found', the past of 'find'.

senses.definition: a lot, or to a great degree

examples.text: It rained heavily all night.

senses.usageNote: Say 'rain heavily' or 'heavy rain', not 'big rain'.

senses.definition: relating to the past or to history

examples.text: I enjoy reading historical novels.

senses.definition: always telling the truth and not cheating

examples.text: Thank you for being honest with me.

senses.usageNote: The 'h' is silent, so we say 'an honest person'.

senses.definition: more and more over time

examples.text: Online shopping is becoming increasingly popular.

senses.definition: to say firmly that something must happen or is true

examples.text: My mum insists on everyone eating breakfast together.

translations.zh: 我妈妈坚持要大家一起吃早饭。

senses.usageNote: We say 'insist on doing something' or 'insist that...', not 'insist to do something'.

senses.definition: information or an order that tells you how to do something

examples.text: Read the instructions before you build the model.

translations.zh: 组装模型之前先读说明书。

senses.usageNote: When it means a guide to using something, 'instructions' is usually plural.

senses.definition: inside something, such as the body, a country or an organisation

examples.text: The heart and lungs are internal organs.

senses.definition: very big

examples.text: There was a massive queue outside the cinema.

translations.zh: 电影院外排着很长的队。

senses.definition: only; just

examples.text: I was merely trying to help.

senses.definition: a smaller part of a group, less than half

examples.text: Only a minority of students chose the art class.

translations.zh: 只有少数学生选了美术课。

senses.definition: connected with the place where you were born; (of plants and animals) living naturally in a place

examples.text: Her native language is Spanish.
Kangaroos are native to Australia.

senses.definition: the result of an action or event

examples.text: We are waiting for the outcome of the competition.

senses.definition: to put things into a bag or box to take them somewhere

examples.text: Have you packed your suitcase yet?

senses.definition: a small box or bag of things sold together

examples.text: I bought a pack of coloured pencils.

senses.definition: the area next to the track where you get on and off a train

examples.text: The train to Oxford leaves from platform 4.

translations.zh: 开往牛津的火车从4号站台发车。

senses.definition: a lot, or more than enough

examples.text: Don't worry, we have plenty of time.

translations.zh: 别担心，我们有的是时间。

senses.usageNote: Use 'plenty of' before a noun: 'plenty of food', not 'plenty food'.

senses.definition: something that is more important than other things

examples.text: My top priority this week is finishing my project.

translations.zh: 我这周的首要任务是完成项目。

senses.definition: the correct or usual way of doing something

examples.text: Everyone must learn the fire safety procedure.

translations.zh: 每个人都必须学习消防安全程序。

senses.definition: pleased about something you or someone close to you has done

examples.text: My parents were proud of my school report.

translations.zh: 我的父母为我的成绩单感到自豪。

senses.usageNote: We say 'proud of' someone or something, not 'proud for' or 'proud about'.

senses.definition: to become healthy again after an illness or injury

examples.text: She recovered quickly from her cold.

senses.definition: connected with what is being discussed or done

examples.text: Only include information that is relevant to the question.

translations.zh: 只写与问题相关的信息。

senses.definition: the way you go from one place to another

examples.text: What's the fastest route to the airport?

translations.zh: 去机场最快的路线是哪条？

senses.definition: connected with science

examples.text: They did a scientific study of the river water.

translations.zh: 他们对河水做了一项科学研究。

senses.definition: to go and live in a place permanently

examples.text: Her family settled in Canada ten years ago.

translations.zh: 她家十年前在加拿大定居了。

senses.definition: to end an argument by agreeing

examples.text: They settled the argument quickly.

senses.definition: a strong feeling of surprise when something unexpected happens

examples.text: The news came as a shock to everyone.

translations.zh: 这个消息让所有人都很震惊。

senses.definition: a time when there is no sound or nobody speaks

examples.text: The students worked in silence.

translations.zh: 学生们安静地做着作业。

senses.definition: to be likely to cause harm or damage to something

examples.text: Dark clouds threatened to spoil our day at the beach.

translations.zh: 乌云眼看要毁了我们在海滩的一天。

senses.definition: used to say that something is sad or disappointing

examples.text: Unfortunately, the museum was closed.

translations.zh: 遗憾的是，博物馆关门了。

senses.definition: extremely large

examples.text: The desert is a vast, empty place.

translations.zh: 沙漠是一片广阔而空旷的地方。

senses.definition: by many people or in many places

examples.text: English is widely spoken around the world.

translations.zh: 英语在世界各地被广泛使用。

senses.definition: an area that is different from the areas around it or used for a special purpose

examples.text: This part of the park is a quiet zone.

translations.zh: 公园的这一部分是安静区。

senses.definition: working well without wasting time, money or effort

examples.text: Spaced repetition is an efficient way to study.

translations.zh: 间隔重复是一种高效的学习方式。

senses.usageNote: 'Efficient' is about not wasting effort; 'effective' is about getting the result at all.

senses.definition: to make someone believe something or agree to do it

examples.text: She convinced me to try again.

senses.definition: to promise that something will happen or is true

examples.text: I can't guarantee it will work.

senses.definition: progress or a new development in something

examples.text: There have been huge advances in medicine.

translations.zh: 医学已经取得了巨大的进步。

senses.usageNote: 'In advance' means 'before': 'Book your tickets in advance.'

senses.definition: very old, or from a time thousands of years ago

examples.text: We visited an ancient temple in the mountains.

translations.zh: 我们参观了山里的一座古庙。

senses.definition: in the most important ways; used to give a simple explanation

examples.text: Basically, the game is about collecting stars.

translations.zh: 总的来说，这个游戏就是收集星星。

senses.definition: all the actors in a film or play

examples.text: The cast of the school play took a bow.

translations.zh: 校园剧的全体演员鞠躬谢幕。

senses.definition: the front part of your body between your neck and stomach

examples.text: He folded his arms across his chest.

senses.definition: a person you work with

examples.text: My mum had lunch with her colleagues.

translations.zh: 妈妈和同事们一起吃了午饭。

senses.definition: something you say or write to show you are not happy about something

examples.text: We made a complaint about the cold food.

translations.zh: 我们投诉了饭菜是冷的。

senses.definition: to decide something is true after thinking about the facts; also, to end

examples.text: The scientists concluded that the water was safe.

translations.zh: 科学家们得出结论：水是安全的。

senses.definition: (of a computer) to stop working suddenly; also, to hit something hard

examples.text: My computer crashed and I lost my work.

translations.zh: 我的电脑死机了，我的作业丢了。

senses.definition: good at thinking of new ideas or making new things

examples.text: She is very creative and loves to draw.

translations.zh: 她很有创造力，喜欢画画。

senses.definition: a time when you have to wait longer than expected

examples.text: There was a two-hour delay because of the snow.

translations.zh: 因为下雪，延误了两个小时。

senses.definition: to make something happen later than planned

examples.text: The train was delayed by twenty minutes.

senses.definition: something very bad that happens and causes great damage; a complete failure

examples.text: The floods were a disaster for the farmers.

translations.zh: 洪水对农民来说是一场灾难。

senses.definition: sudden and surprising, or very exciting

examples.text: There has been a dramatic change in the weather.

translations.zh: 天气发生了急剧的变化。

senses.definition: a formal test; a careful look at something

examples.text: The examination starts at nine o'clock.

senses.usageNote: 'Exam' is the normal short form. We 'take' or 'sit' an exam and 'pass' or 'fail' it.

senses.definition: to send goods to another country to sell them

examples.text: The farm exports apples to many countries.

translations.zh: 这个农场把苹果出口到许多国家。

senses.definition: for all time; always

examples.text: I'll remember this day forever.

senses.definition: the act of getting better, or a change that makes something better

examples.text: There has been a big improvement in your writing.

translations.zh: 你的写作有了很大的进步。

senses.usageNote: We say 'an improvement in' something (it got better) and 'an improvement on' something (better than the earlier one).

senses.definition: the ability to decide and act without being told; a new plan

examples.text: She took the initiative and organised the class trip.

translations.zh: 她主动组织了班级旅行。

senses.definition: an object used to make music, or a tool for careful work

examples.text: Do you play a musical instrument?

senses.definition: the smallest amount or number that is possible or allowed

examples.text: You need a minimum of four players for this game.

translations.zh: 这个游戏最少需要四个玩家。

senses.definition: to get something, especially with effort

examples.text: You can obtain a map from the tourist office.

translations.zh: 你可以在旅游咨询处拿到地图。

senses.usageNote: 'Obtain' is formal. In everyday speech, 'get' is more natural.

senses.definition: the study of ideas about life and knowledge; also a set of beliefs about how to live

examples.text: My grandad's philosophy is to enjoy every day.

translations.zh: 我爷爷的人生信条是享受每一天。

senses.definition: only if; on the condition that

examples.text: You can go out, provided you finish your homework first.

translations.zh: 只要你先写完作业，就可以出去。

senses.definition: to repeat the exact words that someone else said or wrote

examples.text: He quoted a line from his favourite poem.

translations.zh: 他引用了他最喜欢的诗中的一句。

senses.definition: fair and sensible

examples.text: That sounds like a reasonable idea.

translations.zh: 那听起来是个合理的想法。

senses.definition: (of a price) not too high

examples.text: The food there is good and the prices are reasonable.

translations.zh: 那里的食物很好，价格也公道。

senses.definition: to find an answer to a problem or end a disagreement

examples.text: The teacher helped us resolve our argument.

translations.zh: 老师帮我们解决了争执。

senses.definition: to start a company or organisation; to prepare equipment so it is ready to use

examples.text: They want to set up a reading club at school.

translations.zh: 他们想在学校成立一个读书俱乐部。

examples.cloze: They want to {{set up}} a reading club at school.

senses.definition: to find an answer to a problem or puzzle

examples.text: Can you solve this maths problem?

senses.definition: a small piece of useful advice

examples.text: Here's a tip: write new words on cards.

translations.zh: 给你个小窍门：把新单词写在卡片上。

senses.definition: extra money you give to a waiter or driver to thank them

examples.text: We left a tip for the waiter.

translations.zh: 我们给服务员留了小费。

senses.definition: higher than something else, or at the top

examples.text: The bedrooms are on the upper floor.

senses.definition: extremely important or necessary

translations.zh: 至关重要的；必不可少的

examples.text: Sleep is vital for growing children.

translations.zh: 睡眠对成长中的孩子至关重要。

senses.definition: a large amount of money or valuable things

examples.text: Health is more important than wealth.

senses.definition: the health and happiness of a person or animal

examples.text: The zoo cares about the welfare of its animals.

translations.zh: 这家动物园很关心动物的福利。

senses.definition: to see something happen

examples.text: We witnessed a beautiful sunrise from the mountain.

translations.zh: 我们在山上目睹了美丽的日出。

senses.definition: a person who sees something happen, such as an accident

examples.text: The police asked witnesses what they saw.

translations.zh: 警察询问了目击者看到了什么。

senses.definition: real, not false or pretended

examples.text: She showed genuine interest in the subject.

translations.zh: 她对这个话题表现出真正的兴趣。

senses.definition: to give all your attention to one thing

examples.text: I can't concentrate with the television on.

senses.usageNote: 'Concentrate on something'.

senses.definition: to say that you are unhappy about something

examples.text: They complained about the noise.

senses.usageNote: 'Complain about' something; 'complain to' a person.

senses.definition: connected with schools, universities and studying

examples.text: The academic year starts in September.

senses.definition: easy to see or understand

examples.text: It soon became apparent that we were lost.

translations.zh: 很快就能看出我们迷路了。

senses.definition: official permission, or the feeling that something is good

examples.text: You need your parents' approval to join the trip.

translations.zh: 参加这次旅行需要父母的同意。

senses.definition: the name of a product made by a particular company

examples.text: Which brand of toothpaste do you use?

senses.usageNote: 'Brand new' means completely new: 'a brand new bike'.

senses.definition: having the skill or ability to do something

examples.text: She is capable of running the whole shop.

senses.usageNote: Say 'capable of doing something', not 'capable to do'. Compare 'able to do'.

senses.definition: the act of looking at how things are similar or different

examples.text: In comparison with last year, it's been a dry summer.

translations.zh: 和去年相比，今年夏天很干燥。

senses.definition: to try to win against others

examples.text: Twenty schools will compete in the quiz.

translations.zh: 二十所学校将参加知识竞赛。

senses.definition: modern; belonging to the present time

examples.text: The gallery shows contemporary art.

translations.zh: 这家美术馆展出当代艺术。

senses.definition: a plant grown by farmers, such as rice or wheat

examples.text: Rice is the main crop in this area.

translations.zh: 水稻是这个地区的主要农作物。

senses.definition: to win against someone in a game or competition

examples.text: Our team defeated the champions three goals to one.

translations.zh: 我们队以三比一击败了冠军队。

senses.definition: the act of taking goods or letters to a place

examples.text: Delivery is free for orders over fifty pounds.

translations.zh: 订单满五十英镑免费送货。

senses.definition: the act of finding something new, or the thing that is found

examples.text: The discovery of the old coins surprised everyone.

translations.zh: 发现那些古钱币让所有人都很惊讶。

senses.definition: using small electrical parts such as those in computers and phones

examples.text: The shop sells phones and other electronic goods.

translations.zh: 这家店卖手机和其他电子产品。

senses.definition: to take part in something; to keep someone's interest

examples.text: Good teachers engage students with fun activities.

translations.zh: 好老师用有趣的活动吸引学生。

senses.definition: a long period of time in history

examples.text: We live in the era of smartphones.

translations.zh: 我们生活在智能手机时代。

senses.definition: a belief about what will happen or how good something will be

examples.text: The film was better than my expectations.

translations.zh: 这部电影比我预期的要好。

senses.definition: the responsibility for a mistake; a problem in a machine

examples.text: It wasn't your fault that the glass broke.

senses.definition: a border around a picture or window; the main structure of something

examples.text: I put the photo in a wooden frame.

translations.zh: 我把照片放进一个木相框里。

senses.definition: feeling bad because you did something wrong

examples.text: I felt guilty about eating the last biscuit.

translations.zh: 我吃了最后一块饼干，感到很内疚。

senses.definition: something you do often, almost without thinking

examples.text: Brushing your teeth twice a day is a good habit.

translations.zh: 每天刷两次牙是个好习惯。

senses.usageNote: Say 'have a habit of doing something' or 'get into the habit'. 'Habit' is personal; 'custom' is for a society.

senses.definition: great respect, or something that makes you feel proud

examples.text: It was an honour to meet the famous writer.

translations.zh: 能见到这位著名作家是我的荣幸。

senses.usageNote: British spelling 'honour'; the 'h' is silent, so 'an honour'.

senses.definition: not allowed by the law

examples.text: It is illegal to park in front of the fire station.

translations.zh: 在消防站门前停车是违法的。

senses.definition: a disease in part of the body caused by germs

examples.text: Wash the cut to stop an infection.

senses.definition: the ability to learn, understand and think well

examples.text: Crows show surprising intelligence when solving problems.

translations.zh: 乌鸦在解决问题时表现出惊人的智慧。

senses.definition: to try to find out the facts about something

examples.text: Scientists are investigating why the bees are disappearing.

translations.zh: 科学家正在调查蜜蜂消失的原因。

senses.definition: the largest amount or number that is possible or allowed

examples.text: The lift carries a maximum of eight people.

translations.zh: 这部电梯最多载八个人。

senses.definition: a part of the body that tightens and relaxes to make you move

examples.text: Swimming makes your arm muscles stronger.

translations.zh: 游泳能让你的手臂肌肉更强壮。

senses.definition: used with 'not' to say something is not always true

examples.text: Expensive things are not necessarily better.

senses.definition: an area of a town and the people who live there

examples.text: There's a nice park in our neighbourhood.

translations.zh: 我们社区里有个不错的公园。

senses.definition: to disagree with a plan or idea and try to stop it

examples.text: Many parents opposed the plan to close the library.

translations.zh: 许多家长反对关闭图书馆的计划。

senses.usageNote: We say 'oppose something' or 'be opposed to something', not 'oppose to something'.

senses.definition: completely, or in a perfect way

examples.text: The dress fits you perfectly.

translations.zh: 这条裙子你穿着非常合身。

senses.definition: the act of allowing someone to do something

examples.text: You need your parents' permission to go on the trip.

translations.zh: 你需要得到父母的许可才能参加这次旅行。

senses.usageNote: 'Permission' is uncountable: say 'ask for permission', not 'ask for a permission'.

senses.definition: a stage in a process of change or development

examples.text: The first phase of the new park is finished.

translations.zh: 新公园的第一期工程已经完工。

senses.definition: not mixed with anything else; clean

examples.text: This juice is made from pure orange.

translations.zh: 这种果汁是用纯橙子做的。

senses.definition: an amount or number of something

examples.text: Check the quantity of flour in the recipe.

translations.zh: 看一下食谱里面粉的用量。

senses.definition: to show or have a connection between two things

examples.text: The story relates to events in the author's childhood.

translations.zh: 这个故事与作者童年时的经历有关。

senses.definition: to understand someone's feelings because you have had similar experiences

examples.text: Many students can relate to her story.

translations.zh: 很多学生都能对她的故事产生共鸣。

senses.definition: a member of your family

examples.text: We visit our relatives during the Spring Festival.

translations.zh: 春节期间我们会走亲戚。

senses.definition: a good feeling when something unpleasant stops or does not happen

examples.text: It was a relief to find my lost phone.

translations.zh: 找到丢失的手机真让我松了一口气。

senses.usageNote: A common phrase is 'What a relief!' when you feel less worried.

senses.definition: unusual or surprising in a way that makes people notice

examples.text: She made remarkable progress in just one year.

translations.zh: 她仅用一年就取得了显著进步。

senses.definition: to stop yourself from doing something you want to do

examples.text: I couldn't resist eating another cake.

translations.zh: 我忍不住又吃了一块蛋糕。

senses.usageNote: 'Resist' is followed by a noun or -ing form: 'resist the temptation', 'resist laughing'.

senses.definition: safe, or fixed firmly so it will not move or be lost

examples.text: Keep your password secure.

senses.definition: to make your arms, legs or body as long as possible

examples.text: Always stretch before you go running.

translations.zh: 跑步前一定要做伸展运动。

senses.definition: an amount of money

examples.text: He saved a large sum of money for university.

translations.zh: 他为上大学存了一大笔钱。

senses.definition: a simple calculation with numbers

examples.text: The children are doing sums in class.

translations.zh: 孩子们在课上做算术题。

senses.definition: the main subject or idea of something

examples.text: The theme of the party is 'under the sea'.

translations.zh: 派对的主题是'海底世界'。

senses.definition: to change something completely, usually to make it better

examples.text: They transformed the old garage into a music room.

translations.zh: 他们把旧车库改造成了音乐室。

senses.definition: different from what is normal or common

examples.text: It's unusual for him to be so quiet.

senses.definition: a very small living thing that causes illness, or a harmful computer program

examples.text: A cold is caused by a virus.

senses.definition: next to, or together with

examples.text: I worked alongside my dad in the garden.

translations.zh: 我和爸爸一起在花园里干活。

senses.definition: to judge how good, big or important something is

examples.text: Teachers assess our progress every term.

translations.zh: 老师每学期评估我们的进步。

senses.definition: the feeling or mood that a place or situation has

examples.text: The café has a warm, friendly atmosphere.

translations.zh: 这家咖啡馆氛围温馨友好。

senses.definition: the air around the Earth

examples.text: The Earth's atmosphere protects us from the sun.

translations.zh: 地球的大气层保护我们免受太阳伤害。

senses.definition: pleasant to look at, or interesting enough to want

examples.text: The hotel offers an attractive price for families.

translations.zh: 这家酒店为家庭提供很有吸引力的价格。

senses.definition: to take air into your body and let it out again

examples.text: Fish breathe through their gills.

senses.definition: relaxed and not worried, angry or excited

examples.text: Try to stay calm during the test.

senses.usageNote: The 'l' is silent: /kɑːm/. 'Calm down' means to become calm.

senses.definition: a typical quality or feature of someone or something

examples.text: Long ears are a characteristic of this rabbit.

translations.zh: 长耳朵是这种兔子的特征。

senses.definition: a line of things going down a page; also, a tall stone post

examples.text: Write the dates in the first column.

senses.usageNote: The final 'n' is silent: /ˈkɒləm/.

senses.definition: to share information or feelings with someone

examples.text: Dolphins communicate using sounds.

senses.definition: a person whose job is to give opinions about books, films, food, etc.

examples.text: The film critic loved the new cartoon.

translations.zh: 这位影评人很喜欢这部新动画片。

senses.definition: to say something officially or clearly so that everyone knows

examples.text: The judges declared her the winner of the contest.

translations.zh: 评委宣布她是比赛的获胜者。

senses.definition: a kind of energy that gives power to lights and machines

examples.text: Turn off the lights to save electricity.

senses.definition: special importance or attention given to something

examples.text: Our school puts a strong emphasis on reading.

translations.zh: 我们学校非常重视阅读。

senses.usageNote: Use 'emphasis on': 'put emphasis on something'.

senses.definition: films, music, shows and other things that people enjoy

examples.text: There's plenty of entertainment on the ship.

senses.usageNote: 'Entertainment' is usually uncountable: 'a lot of entertainment', not 'many entertainments'.

senses.definition: someone or something that does not follow the usual rule

examples.text: Everyone must wear a helmet, and there are no exceptions.

translations.zh: 每个人都必须戴头盔，没有例外。

senses.definition: a show of paintings or other objects for people to look at

examples.text: We visited a dinosaur exhibition at the museum.

translations.zh: 我们去博物馆看了恐龙展。

senses.definition: a large amount of water covering an area that is usually dry

examples.text: The heavy rain caused a flood in the village.

senses.definition: a building or room where people can see paintings and art

examples.text: We saw some famous paintings at the art gallery.

translations.zh: 我们在美术馆看了一些名画。

senses.definition: the best possible; perfect for a purpose

examples.text: This park is ideal for a picnic.

translations.zh: 这个公园非常适合野餐。

senses.definition: the idea or feeling you get about someone or something

examples.text: First impressions are very important in a job interview.

translations.zh: 在求职面试中，第一印象非常重要。

senses.usageNote: The usual phrase is 'make a good impression on someone', not 'give someone a good impression'.

senses.definition: something heavy that is carried; also, informally, a lot

examples.text: The truck was carrying a load of wood.

senses.definition: to put things into a vehicle or machine

examples.text: We loaded the bags into the car.

senses.definition: the way you feel at a particular time

examples.text: She's in a good mood today.

senses.usageNote: We say 'in a good/bad mood'. 'I'm not in the mood' means you don't want to do something now.

senses.definition: connected with what is right and wrong

examples.text: Helping others is a moral duty.

translations.zh: 帮助他人是一种道德责任。

senses.definition: a lesson about how to behave that you learn from a story

examples.text: The moral of the story is to always tell the truth.

translations.zh: 这个故事的寓意是永远要说实话。

senses.definition: the place or way something starts

examples.text: Do you know the origin of this word?

translations.zh: 你知道这个单词的来源吗？

senses.definition: to some degree, but not completely

examples.text: The sky was partly cloudy.

senses.definition: a short part of a book or text; also a narrow way between rooms or buildings

examples.text: Read the passage and answer the questions.

translations.zh: 阅读这段文章并回答问题。

senses.definition: lasting for a very long time or for ever

examples.text: She has found a permanent job at the library.

translations.zh: 她在图书馆找到了一份长期工作。

senses.definition: a particular way of thinking about something

examples.text: Travelling helps you see things from a new perspective.

translations.zh: 旅行能帮你从新的角度看待事物。

senses.definition: a small group of words used together

examples.text: Learn some useful phrases before your trip to France.

translations.zh: 去法国之前学一些有用的短语。

senses.definition: to say what you think will happen in the future

examples.text: They predict sunny weather for the weekend.

translations.zh: 他们预测周末会是晴天。

senses.definition: a person who lives in a particular place

examples.text: Local residents helped to clean the park.

translations.zh: 当地居民帮忙打扫了公园。

senses.definition: to move or do something very quickly because you do not have much time

examples.text: Don't rush your homework — take your time.

senses.usageNote: 'Be in a rush' means 'be in a hurry'. 'Rush hour' is the busy travel time.

senses.definition: happening quickly and without warning

examples.text: There was a sudden change in the weather.

senses.usageNote: The fixed phrase 'all of a sudden' means 'suddenly'.

senses.definition: a feeling of worry or nervousness

examples.text: You could feel the tension in the room before the final.

translations.zh: 决赛前，你能感觉到房间里的紧张气氛。

senses.definition: fitting your body very closely, sometimes too closely

examples.text: These shoes are too tight for me.

senses.definition: to add the newest information to something, or make it more modern

examples.text: I need to update the app on my phone.

translations.zh: 我需要更新手机上的应用。

senses.definition: to tell someone what you think they should do

examples.text: The doctor advised me to rest for a week.

senses.usageNote: 'Advise' (with s, /z/) is the verb; 'advice' (with c, /s/) is the uncountable noun.

senses.definition: to connect one thing with another in your mind

examples.text: I always associate this song with summer.

translations.zh: 我总把这首歌和夏天联系在一起。

senses.definition: to catch a person or animal; also, to show something well in a picture or words

examples.text: The photo captures the beauty of the lake.

translations.zh: 这张照片捕捉到了湖泊的美。

senses.definition: to make someone feel less sad or worried

examples.text: She comforted her friend after the match.

translations.zh: 比赛后她安慰了她的朋友。

senses.definition: a pleasant feeling of being relaxed and free from pain

examples.text: These shoes are designed for comfort.

translations.zh: 这双鞋是为舒适而设计的。

senses.definition: to meet someone or experience something, often unexpectedly

examples.text: We encountered a few problems on the way.

translations.zh: 我们在路上遇到了一些问题。

senses.definition: very unusual or surprising

examples.text: She has an extraordinary talent for music.

senses.definition: basic and very important

examples.text: Clean water is a fundamental need.

translations.zh: 清洁的水是一项基本需求。

senses.definition: very large

examples.text: We saw a giant panda at the zoo.

translations.zh: 我们在动物园看到了一只大熊猫。

senses.definition: to finish your studies at a university or school

examples.text: My sister graduated from university last summer.

translations.zh: 我姐姐去年夏天大学毕业了。

senses.usageNote: Use 'graduate from': 'graduate from university'. As a verb it ends /eɪt/; as a noun it ends /ət/.

senses.definition: to tell someone about something, especially officially

examples.text: Please inform the teacher if you will be absent.

translations.zh: 如果你要缺席，请通知老师。

senses.usageNote: We 'inform someone of/about something'. Don't say 'inform to someone'.

senses.definition: a room or building where scientists do experiments

examples.text: The students did an experiment in the school laboratory.

translations.zh: 学生们在学校实验室里做了一个实验。

senses.definition: a flat amount of something that lies on or between other things

examples.text: The cake has three layers of chocolate.

translations.zh: 这个蛋糕有三层巧克力。

senses.definition: to watch or check something carefully over a period of time

examples.text: The app monitors how many steps you walk each day.

translations.zh: 这个应用会记录你每天走了多少步。

senses.definition: a computer screen

examples.text: I need a bigger monitor for my computer.

translations.zh: 我的电脑需要一个更大的显示器。

senses.definition: not far away

examples.text: We had lunch at a nearby café.

translations.zh: 我们在附近的一家咖啡馆吃了午饭。

senses.definition: despite what has just been said

examples.text: The test was hard. Nevertheless, everyone passed.

translations.zh: 考试很难，不过大家都及格了。

senses.definition: a very strong interest in or love of something

examples.text: He has a real passion for football.

senses.usageNote: We say 'a passion for' something.

senses.definition: an amount shown as a part of 100

examples.text: A high percentage of students passed the exam.

translations.zh: 很高比例的学生通过了考试。

senses.usageNote: Use 'per cent' with a number (40 per cent) and 'percentage' without one (a large percentage).

senses.definition: to allow something, especially officially

examples.text: Dogs are not permitted in the shop.

senses.definition: the work of getting ready for something

examples.text: Good preparation is the key to passing exams.

translations.zh: 充分的准备是通过考试的关键。

senses.definition: to need or trust someone or something to help you

examples.text: You can always rely on your friends.

translations.zh: 你总是可以依靠你的朋友。

senses.usageNote: Always use 'rely on' or 'rely upon': 'rely on your parents', not 'rely your parents'.

senses.definition: not smooth or even

examples.text: The road was rough and full of stones.

translations.zh: 路面坑洼不平，满是石头。

senses.definition: not exact; approximate

examples.text: Can you give me a rough idea of the cost?

translations.zh: 你能告诉我大概的费用吗？

senses.definition: firm and not likely to move or change

examples.text: Make sure the ladder is stable before you climb it.

translations.zh: 爬梯子之前要确保它是稳的。

senses.definition: to give a piece of work or a form to someone officially

examples.text: Please submit your essays by Friday.

senses.definition: right or good for a particular person, purpose or situation

examples.text: This film is suitable for children.

translations.zh: 这部电影适合儿童观看。

senses.usageNote: Use 'suitable for': 'suitable for beginners'.

senses.definition: a sign, picture or object that represents an idea

examples.text: The dove is a symbol of peace.

senses.definition: a natural ability to do something well

examples.text: She has a real talent for drawing.

senses.usageNote: Use 'a talent for something': 'a talent for music'.

senses.definition: to pull something so that it breaks into pieces or gets a hole

examples.text: Be careful not to tear the paper.

senses.usageNote: The noun 'tear' (drop of water from your eye) is pronounced /tɪə/.

senses.definition: final, after a long process; or the best possible

examples.text: Our ultimate goal is to win the championship.

translations.zh: 我们的最终目标是赢得冠军。

senses.definition: all of space, including all the stars and planets

examples.text: The universe is bigger than we can imagine.

translations.zh: 宇宙比我们能想象的还要大。

senses.definition: not known or not famous

examples.text: The painting is by an unknown artist.

translations.zh: 这幅画出自一位不知名的画家。

senses.definition: connected with towns and cities

examples.text: More people now live in urban areas than in the countryside.

translations.zh: 现在住在城市的人比住在农村的多。

senses.definition: to strongly advise someone to do something

examples.text: The doctor urged him to get more rest.

senses.definition: a strong wish to do something

examples.text: I had a sudden urge to eat chocolate.

senses.definition: able to be seen

examples.text: The stars were clearly visible last night.

senses.definition: connected with seeing or with pictures

examples.text: Pictures and videos are useful visual aids.

translations.zh: 图片和视频是有用的视觉辅助工具。

senses.definition: a person who offers to do something without being paid

examples.text: Volunteers helped to clean the beach.

translations.zh: 志愿者们帮忙清理了海滩。

senses.definition: to take money out of a bank account

examples.text: I need to withdraw some cash from the machine.

translations.zh: 我需要从取款机取些现金。

senses.definition: to stop taking part in something

examples.text: She withdrew from the race because of a sore foot.
examples.cloze: She {{withdrew}} from the race because of a sore foot.

translations.zh: 她因为脚痛退出了比赛。

senses.definition: able to change or be changed easily to suit a situation

examples.text: My schedule is flexible this week.

senses.definition: wanting to know or learn about something

examples.text: I'm curious about how it works.

translations.zh: 我很好奇它是怎么运作的。

senses.definition: strange or unusual

examples.text: There was a curious smell in the room.

translations.zh: 房间里有股奇怪的味道。

senses.definition: to get or gain something, such as a skill or an object

examples.text: Children acquire language very naturally.

translations.zh: 儿童非常自然地习得语言。

senses.definition: to one side, or kept for later

examples.text: I put some money aside for a new bike.

translations.zh: 我存了些钱准备买新自行车。

senses.definition: to fix or join one thing to another

examples.text: I've attached the photos to this email.

translations.zh: 我在这封邮件里附上了照片。

senses.definition: under or below something

examples.text: We found a small box beneath the floor.

translations.zh: 我们在地板下发现了一个小盒子。

senses.definition: a close feeling that joins people together

examples.text: There is a strong bond between the twins.

translations.zh: 这对双胞胎之间有很深的感情纽带。

senses.definition: a person or team that has won a competition

examples.text: She is the national swimming champion.

senses.definition: a competition to find the best player or team

examples.text: Our team won the championship last year.

translations.zh: 我们队去年赢得了锦标赛。

senses.definition: any living thing that can move, such as an animal or insect

examples.text: Strange creatures live at the bottom of the sea.

translations.zh: 海底生活着奇怪的生物。

senses.definition: a group of twelve

examples.text: Mum bought a dozen eggs at the market.

translations.zh: 妈妈在市场买了一打鸡蛋。

senses.usageNote: After a number, 'dozen' has no -s: 'two dozen eggs'. 'Dozens of' means a lot.

senses.definition: to show that something is especially important

examples.text: The coach emphasised the need to warm up.

translations.zh: 教练强调了热身的必要性。

senses.usageNote: Say 'emphasise something', not 'emphasise on something'.

senses.definition: the money you spend on something

examples.text: Having a pet can be a big expense.

translations.zh: 养宠物可能是一笔不小的开支。

senses.definition: to show something that was hidden; to leave something without protection

examples.text: Don't expose your skin to strong sunlight for too long.

translations.zh: 别让皮肤在强烈阳光下暴露太久。

senses.definition: to pay to use something for a short time; to give someone a job

examples.text: We hired bikes and rode around the lake.

translations.zh: 我们租了自行车绕湖骑行。

senses.usageNote: In British English you 'hire' a car or bike for a short time; you 'rent' a flat for a long time.

senses.definition: the ability to make good decisions, or an opinion you form

examples.text: I trust your judgement, so you choose.

translations.zh: 我相信你的判断，你来选吧。

senses.definition: a piece of paper on something that gives information about it

examples.text: Always check the label for the washing instructions.

translations.zh: 一定要看标签上的洗涤说明。

senses.definition: everything you can see when you look across a large area of land

examples.text: The landscape in Scotland is wild and beautiful.

translations.zh: 苏格兰的风景原始而美丽。

senses.definition: the amount of something that a person, machine or company produces

examples.text: The factory has doubled its output this year.

translations.zh: 这家工厂今年的产量翻了一番。

senses.definition: the speed at which something happens or someone moves

examples.text: You can learn at your own pace with this app.

translations.zh: 用这个应用你可以按自己的节奏学习。

senses.definition: the pointed top of a mountain, or the highest level of something

examples.text: We could see snow on the mountain peaks.

translations.zh: 我们能看到山顶上的积雪。

senses.definition: a punishment for breaking a rule; in football, a free kick at goal

examples.text: There is a penalty for returning library books late.

translations.zh: 图书馆的书逾期归还要罚款。

senses.definition: used to give your own opinion; also done by you, not someone else

examples.text: Personally, I prefer summer to winter.

translations.zh: 就我个人而言，我更喜欢夏天而不是冬天。

senses.definition: facts or information that show something is true

examples.text: Do you have any proof that you paid?

senses.usageNote: 'Proof' is the noun and 'prove' is the verb.

senses.definition: to pay money to use something that belongs to someone else

examples.text: We rented bikes and rode around the lake.

translations.zh: 我们租了自行车，绕着湖骑了一圈。

senses.usageNote: 'Rent' can also mean to let others use your property for money: 'They rent their flat to students.'

senses.definition: money you pay regularly to live in a place

examples.text: The rent for this flat is quite high.

translations.zh: 这套公寓的租金相当高。

senses.definition: very bad or serious

examples.text: The farm was damaged by severe storms.

senses.definition: a type of solid, liquid or gas

examples.text: Water is the most common substance on Earth's surface.

translations.zh: 水是地球表面最常见的物质。

senses.definition: as much as is needed

examples.text: Make sure you get sufficient sleep before the exam.

translations.zh: 考试前一定要保证充足的睡眠。

senses.definition: money you earn for work, usually paid each week or by the hour

examples.text: He earns a good wage at the factory.

translations.zh: 他在工厂挣的工资不错。

senses.definition: to make someone agree to do something by giving reasons

examples.text: I persuaded her to join the class.

translations.zh: 我说服她加入了这个班。

senses.definition: able to be trusted to do what is expected

examples.text: He's a reliable colleague.

senses.definition: something good that you have done by working hard

examples.text: Finishing the marathon was a great achievement.

translations.zh: 跑完马拉松是一项了不起的成就。

senses.definition: to take a child or animal into your family and look after it as your own

examples.text: We adopted a cat from the animal shelter.

translations.zh: 我们从动物收容所领养了一只猫。

senses.definition: to start to use a new idea, plan or way of doing something

examples.text: The school adopted a new timetable.

translations.zh: 学校采用了新的课程表。

senses.definition: about; close to a number but not exact

examples.text: The journey takes approximately two hours.

translations.zh: 这段路程大约需要两个小时。

senses.definition: to help someone

examples.text: A nurse assisted the doctor during the check-up.

senses.usageNote: 'Assist' is more formal than 'help'. Say 'assist someone with something' or 'assist in doing something'.

senses.definition: to officially say that something is not allowed

examples.text: Mobile phones are banned during exams.

translations.zh: 考试期间禁止使用手机。

senses.definition: to annoy or worry someone, or to interrupt them

examples.text: Sorry to bother you, but can I ask a question?

translations.zh: 抱歉打扰一下，我能问个问题吗？

senses.usageNote: 'Don't bother' means 'you don't need to do it': 'Don't bother cooking, we'll eat out.'

senses.definition: to continue doing something

examples.text: Please carry on with your reading.
examples.cloze: Please {{carry on}} with your reading.

senses.definition: the time when someone is a child

examples.text: She had a happy childhood by the sea.

translations.zh: 她在海边度过了快乐的童年。

senses.definition: difficult to understand or do because it has many parts

examples.text: The rules of this game are too complicated.

translations.zh: 这个游戏的规则太复杂了。

senses.definition: a sentence that explains what a word means

examples.text: Look up the definition in your dictionary.

translations.zh: 在词典里查一下这个定义。

senses.definition: to understand or solve something after thinking about it

examples.text: I can't figure out how to open this box.

translations.zh: 我弄不明白怎么打开这个盒子。

examples.cloze: I can't {{figure out}} how to open this box.

senses.definition: a very large amount of money; luck

examples.text: That painting must be worth a fortune.

translations.zh: 那幅画一定值一大笔钱。

senses.definition: something you plan or want to do

examples.text: I have no intention of giving up.

senses.definition: to put money, time or effort into something to get an advantage later

examples.text: The school invested in new computers.

translations.zh: 学校投资购买了新电脑。
