senses.usageNote: We 'invest in' something, not 'invest on' something.

senses.definition: in the middle between small and large

examples.text: I'd like a medium pizza, please.

senses.definition: the type of person you are, shown by how you behave and feel

examples.text: My brother has a very friendly personality.

senses.definition: to continue, or to go to a place

examples.text: Passengers should proceed to gate 12.

senses.definition: to try to achieve something over a long time; also to follow someone

examples.text: She left her job to pursue a career in music.

translations.zh: 她辞掉工作去追求音乐事业。

senses.definition: to pass the exams for a job, or to win a place in the next part of a competition

examples.text: Our team qualified for the final.

translations.zh: 我们队获得了决赛资格。

senses.definition: not happening or seen very often

examples.text: This bird is very rare in China.

translations.zh: 这种鸟在中国非常罕见。

senses.definition: (of meat) cooked only a little, so it is still red inside

examples.text: He likes his steak rare.

senses.definition: not often

examples.text: It rarely snows in my city.

translations.zh: 我所在的城市很少下雪。

senses.usageNote: 'Rarely' already has a negative meaning, so don't add 'not': 'I rarely go', not 'I don't rarely go'.

senses.definition: the opinion that people have about someone or something

examples.text: The restaurant has a good reputation for its noodles.

translations.zh: 这家餐馆的面条很有名。

senses.definition: something given to someone because they have done something good

examples.text: As a reward for her hard work, she got a new bike.

translations.zh: 作为对她努力的奖励，她得到了一辆新自行车。

senses.definition: to use all of something so there is none left

examples.text: We have run out of milk, so I'll buy some.

translations.zh: 我们的牛奶喝完了，我去买一些。

examples.cloze: We have {{run out}} of milk, so I'll buy some.

senses.usageNote: Use 'run out of + thing': 'run out of time', 'run out of money'.

senses.definition: easily upset by things people say or do

examples.text: He's very sensitive about his height.

translations.zh: 他对自己的身高很敏感。

senses.definition: easily hurt or affected by something

examples.text: This cream is for sensitive skin.

translations.zh: 这款面霜适合敏感肌肤。

senses.definition: a series of things that happen or are arranged in a particular order

examples.text: Put the pictures in the right sequence to tell the story.

translations.zh: 把图片按正确顺序排好来讲故事。

senses.definition: small and not important

examples.text: I have a slight headache.

senses.definition: to look at someone or something for a long time

examples.text: It's not polite to stare at people.

translations.zh: 盯着别人看是不礼貌的。

senses.usageNote: Use 'stare at someone/something'.

senses.definition: a thin piece of cord used for tying things

examples.text: Tie the box with a piece of string.

translations.zh: 用一根绳子把盒子捆起来。

senses.definition: one of the long thin wires on an instrument such as a guitar

examples.text: One of the guitar strings is broken.

senses.definition: an idea or plan that you offer for people to think about

examples.text: Does anyone have a suggestion for the class trip?

translations.zh: 关于班级旅行，有人有建议吗？

senses.usageNote: We 'make a suggestion', not 'give a suggestion' or 'say a suggestion'.

senses.definition: a short statement that gives only the main points

examples.text: Write a short summary of the story.

translations.zh: 写一段这个故事的简短概要。

senses.definition: to move backwards and forwards or from side to side

examples.text: The monkeys swing from tree to tree.

translations.zh: 猴子在树与树之间荡来荡去。

senses.definition: a seat hanging from ropes that children sit on and move

examples.text: The kids are playing on the swings.

senses.definition: lasting only for a short time

examples.text: She found a temporary job for the summer.

translations.zh: 她找了一份暑期临时工作。

senses.definition: a sign or very small amount that shows something was there

examples.text: The cat disappeared without a trace.

translations.zh: 那只猫消失得无影无踪。

senses.definition: to copy a picture by drawing over its lines through thin paper

examples.text: The children traced the shapes of the letters.

translations.zh: 孩子们描着字母的形状。

senses.definition: to keep someone in a place they cannot escape from

examples.text: We were trapped in the lift for twenty minutes.

translations.zh: 我们被困在电梯里二十分钟。

senses.definition: a clever action done to entertain people, or a way of making someone believe something false

examples.text: My uncle showed us a card trick.

translations.zh: 我叔叔给我们表演了一个纸牌魔术。

senses.definition: the situation when people do not have jobs

examples.text: Unemployment in the town has fallen this year.

translations.zh: 今年这个镇的失业率下降了。

senses.definition: unhappy or worried because something bad has happened

examples.text: She was upset when she lost her favourite toy.

translations.zh: 她弄丢了最喜欢的玩具，很难过。

senses.usageNote: 'An upset stomach' means a stomach that feels ill.

senses.definition: worth a lot of money, or very useful

examples.text: This was a valuable lesson for me.

translations.zh: 这对我来说是宝贵的一课。

senses.usageNote: 'Invaluable' is not the opposite — it means extremely useful. The opposite is 'worthless'.

senses.definition: made to appear real by a computer

examples.text: We took a virtual tour of the museum online.

translations.zh: 我们在网上虚拟参观了博物馆。

senses.definition: in or to any place

examples.text: My dog follows me wherever I go.

translations.zh: 无论我去哪儿，我的狗都跟着我。

senses.definition: to find the answer to something by thinking; to do exercise to get fit

examples.text: I can't work out the answer to this puzzle.

translations.zh: 我想不出这个谜题的答案。

examples.cloze: I can't {{work out}} the answer to this puzzle.

senses.definition: to cover something with paper or cloth

examples.text: Let's wrap the present in red paper.

translations.zh: 我们用红纸把礼物包起来吧。

senses.definition: a time when someone is not in the place where they should be

examples.text: Nobody noticed his absence from the meeting.

translations.zh: 没人注意到他没来开会。

senses.definition: at a high level, or modern and developed

examples.text: She is in the advanced English class.

senses.definition: an arranged time to meet someone, such as a doctor

examples.text: I have a dentist's appointment at four.

senses.usageNote: Use 'appointment' for professional meetings (doctor, bank). For meeting friends, just say 'I'm meeting a friend'.

senses.definition: knowledge or understanding of a subject or situation

examples.text: The project raises awareness about plastic waste.

translations.zh: 这个项目提高了人们对塑料垃圾的意识。

senses.definition: not able to see

examples.text: Her guide dog helps her because she is blind.

translations.zh: 她失明了，导盲犬帮助她。

senses.definition: extremely clever or skilful; also, very good

examples.text: That's a brilliant idea!

senses.definition: a drawing that shows information with lines, bars or pictures

examples.text: This chart shows the weather for each month.

translations.zh: 这张图表显示了每个月的天气。

senses.definition: very good and popular for a long time

examples.text: We watched a classic film from the 1950s.

translations.zh: 我们看了一部五十年代的经典电影。

senses.usageNote: 'Classic' means famous and very good; 'classical' describes music or art from an older, serious tradition.

senses.definition: to fall down suddenly

examples.text: The old bridge collapsed in the storm.

translations.zh: 那座旧桥在暴风雨中倒塌了。

senses.definition: a person or company that is trying to win against others

examples.text: There were fifty competitors in the race.

translations.zh: 这场比赛有五十名参赛者。

senses.definition: a state of not understanding, or a situation where things are mixed up

examples.text: There was some confusion about the meeting time.

translations.zh: 关于会议时间有些混乱。

senses.definition: all the time, or very often

examples.text: My little sister is constantly asking questions.

translations.zh: 我妹妹总是不停地问问题。

senses.definition: to change something into a different form or use

examples.text: They converted the old barn into a house.

translations.zh: 他们把旧谷仓改造成了一栋房子。

senses.definition: an activity of making things by hand with skill

examples.text: We did arts and crafts on Saturday morning.

translations.zh: 我们星期六上午做了手工。

senses.definition: including many small facts or pieces of information

examples.text: She drew a detailed map of the village.

translations.zh: 她画了一张详细的村庄地图。

senses.definition: to be not the same as something else

examples.text: The two cities differ in many ways.

translations.zh: 这两座城市在很多方面不同。

senses.definition: the practice of following rules and controlling how you behave

examples.text: Learning the piano takes a lot of discipline.

translations.zh: 学钢琴需要很强的自律。

senses.definition: one of the forms in which a book or magazine is printed

examples.text: This is the new edition of the dictionary.

translations.zh: 这是这本词典的新版本。

senses.definition: a sudden, bright light that lasts a very short time

examples.text: There was a flash of lightning in the sky.

senses.usageNote: 'In a flash' means very quickly.

senses.definition: to take hold of something suddenly and quickly

examples.text: He grabbed his coat and ran to the bus.

translations.zh: 他抓起外套跑向公交车。

senses.definition: help and advice about what to do

examples.text: With her teacher's guidance, she wrote a great story.

translations.zh: 在老师的指导下，她写了一个很棒的故事。

senses.usageNote: 'Guidance' is uncountable: 'some guidance', not 'a guidance'.

senses.definition: very surprising or extremely good

examples.text: We had an incredible time at the science museum.

translations.zh: 我们在科学博物馆玩得非常开心。

senses.definition: to find the exact position of something; to be in a place

examples.text: The hotel is located near the station.

senses.definition: a dirty or untidy state

examples.text: Your bedroom is a mess!

senses.definition: something strange that nobody can explain

examples.text: Where my other sock went is a mystery.

translations.zh: 我另一只袜子去哪儿了是个谜。

senses.definition: many

examples.text: The museum has numerous paintings from the 1800s.

translations.zh: 博物馆有许多19世纪的画作。

senses.definition: strange or unusual

examples.text: It's odd that he hasn't called us.

translations.zh: 他还没给我们打电话，真奇怪。

senses.definition: (of a number) that cannot be divided exactly by two

examples.text: Three and seven are odd numbers.

senses.definition: to need to pay back money that you borrowed; also to have something because of someone

examples.text: I owe you five pounds for the cinema ticket.

translations.zh: 电影票钱我欠你五英镑。

senses.definition: to take part in an activity

examples.text: All the students participated in the sports day.

translations.zh: 所有学生都参加了运动会。

senses.usageNote: We 'participate in' something. 'Take part in' means the same and is less formal.

senses.definition: the events that make up the story of a book or film

examples.text: The film has a very exciting plot.

translations.zh: 这部电影的情节非常精彩。

senses.definition: damage to air, water or land caused by harmful substances

examples.text: Cars are a major cause of air pollution.

translations.zh: 汽车是空气污染的主要原因之一。

senses.definition: something that you own; the state of having something

examples.text: Pack all your possessions before you move house.

translations.zh: 搬家前把你所有的东西都打包好。

senses.definition: the state of being very poor

examples.text: The charity helps families living in poverty.

translations.zh: 这个慈善机构帮助生活贫困的家庭。

senses.definition: a feeling of happiness about something you or someone close to you has done

examples.text: She showed us her painting with pride.

translations.zh: 她自豪地给我们看她的画。

senses.usageNote: 'Take pride in something' means to care about doing it well.

senses.definition: a job that needs special training or education

examples.text: Teaching is a very rewarding profession.

translations.zh: 教书是一个非常有意义的职业。

senses.definition: the usual order in which you do things every day

examples.text: Reading before bed is part of my daily routine.

translations.zh: 睡前阅读是我的日常习惯之一。

senses.definition: to accept or admit that something is true

examples.text: He acknowledged that he had made a mistake.

senses.definition: the space between two lines that meet, measured in degrees

examples.text: A square has four angles of ninety degrees.

translations.zh: 正方形有四个九十度的角。

senses.definition: a feeling of worry and nervousness

examples.text: Deep breathing can help with exam anxiety.

translations.zh: 深呼吸有助于缓解考试焦虑。

senses.definition: to choose someone officially for a job

examples.text: The school appointed a new head teacher.

translations.zh: 学校任命了一位新校长。

senses.definition: also; used to add another reason

examples.text: I don't want to go out. Besides, it's raining.

translations.zh: 我不想出去。而且，外面在下雨。

senses.definition: to find a number or amount using maths

examples.text: Can you calculate how much we spent?

translations.zh: 你能算一下我们花了多少钱吗？

senses.definition: a formal event with special actions or words

examples.text: The prize-giving ceremony starts at two.

senses.definition: not able to understand or think clearly

examples.text: I was confused by the map.

translations.zh: 这张地图把我弄糊涂了。

senses.usageNote: You feel 'confused'; something that makes you feel this way is 'confusing'.

senses.definition: to build something

examples.text: They constructed a new bridge over the river.

translations.zh: 他们在河上建了一座新桥。

senses.definition: a long flat surface in a shop or bank where you are served

examples.text: Please pay at the counter.

senses.definition: to say what you think is bad about someone or something

examples.text: The coach criticised us for being late.

senses.usageNote: British spelling is 'criticise'; American spelling is 'criticize'. Use 'criticise someone for something'.

senses.definition: the type of money used in a country

examples.text: The currency in Japan is the yen.

senses.definition: to be brave enough to do something

examples.text: Nobody dared to jump into the cold lake.

translations.zh: 没有人敢跳进冰冷的湖里。

examples.text: I don't dare tell my mum about the broken vase.

translations.zh: 我不敢告诉妈妈花瓶打碎了。

senses.usageNote: After 'dare' you can use 'to' or not: 'I didn't dare (to) ask.' 'How dare you!' shows anger.

senses.definition: to notice or discover something that is hard to see, hear or smell

examples.text: This machine can detect smoke very quickly.

translations.zh: 这台机器能很快检测到烟雾。

senses.definition: clearly different or easy to notice

examples.text: The two birds have distinct songs.

translations.zh: 这两种鸟的叫声截然不同。

senses.definition: a first version of a piece of writing that is not finished

examples.text: I wrote the first draft of my essay last night.

translations.zh: 我昨晚写了作文的初稿。

senses.definition: helping people to learn

examples.text: This game is fun and educational.

translations.zh: 这个游戏既有趣又有教育意义。

senses.definition: the quality of doing something well without wasting time or energy

examples.text: New lights have improved the energy efficiency of the school.

translations.zh: 新灯提高了学校的能源效率。

senses.definition: to remove something completely; to beat a team so it leaves a competition

examples.text: Our team was eliminated in the first round.

translations.zh: 我们队在第一轮就被淘汰了。

senses.definition: a short piece of writing on a subject, especially for school

examples.text: I have to write an essay about my hometown.

translations.zh: 我得写一篇关于我家乡的作文。

senses.definition: books and stories about people and events that are not real

examples.text: I enjoy reading science fiction.

senses.definition: the best or most exciting part of something

examples.text: The highlight of the trip was seeing the pandas.

translations.zh: 这次旅行最精彩的部分是看到了大熊猫。

senses.definition: to mark words with a bright colour; to show that something is important

examples.text: Highlight the new words in yellow.

senses.definition: the ability to form new ideas or pictures in your mind

examples.text: Children often have a wonderful imagination.

translations.zh: 孩子们往往有很棒的想象力。

senses.definition: inside or near the centre of something

examples.text: They live in the inner part of the city.

senses.definition: a person who writes news for newspapers, websites, TV or radio

examples.text: The journalist asked the scientist about her discovery.

translations.zh: 记者向科学家询问了她的发现。

senses.definition: the act of watching something carefully; a comment about something you noticed

examples.text: Scientists learn a lot through careful observation.

translations.zh: 科学家通过仔细观察学到很多东西。

senses.definition: sometimes, but not often

examples.text: We occasionally eat out at a restaurant.

senses.definition: a person you are playing against in a game or competition

examples.text: She shook hands with her opponent after the match.

translations.zh: 比赛后她和对手握了手。

senses.definition: a person who takes part in an activity or event

examples.text: Each participant received a T-shirt.

translations.zh: 每位参与者都得到了一件T恤。

senses.definition: to stop doing something for a short time

examples.text: She paused to look at the map.

senses.definition: something that happens or exists, especially something unusual

examples.text: A rainbow is a beautiful natural phenomenon.

translations.zh: 彩虹是一种美丽的自然现象。

senses.definition: simple, with no pattern or extra things added

examples.text: I'd like a plain white T-shirt.

translations.zh: 我想要一件纯白色的T恤。

senses.definition: easy to see or understand

examples.text: Please write in plain English.

senses.definition: a move to a more important job; also activity to help sell a product

examples.text: My dad got a promotion at work.

translations.zh: 我爸爸在工作中升职了。

senses.definition: the study of the mind and how it affects behaviour

examples.text: She wants to study psychology at university.

translations.zh: 她想在大学学习心理学。

senses.definition: to stop doing something, or to leave a job or school

examples.text: She decided to quit the swimming team.

senses.definition: to behave in a certain way because of something that happens

examples.text: How did your parents react to the news?

translations.zh: 你父母对这个消息有什么反应？

senses.usageNote: We react to something: 'react to the news', not 'react the news'.

senses.definition: to repair something old so that it looks like it did before

examples.text: They spent two years restoring the old castle.

translations.zh: 他们花了两年时间修复这座古城堡。

senses.definition: to go down below the surface of water

examples.text: Stones sink, but wood floats.

translations.zh: 石头会下沉，而木头会浮起来。

senses.definition: a bowl in a kitchen or bathroom where you wash things

examples.text: Put the dirty plates in the sink.

senses.definition: extra; kept in case you need it

examples.text: Do you have a spare pen?

senses.usageNote: 'Spare time' means free time: 'What do you do in your spare time?'

senses.definition: developing or happening at a regular, even speed

examples.text: There has been a steady rise in prices.

senses.definition: firm and not shaking

examples.text: Hold the camera steady.

senses.definition: to have a particular weight, or to measure how heavy something is

examples.text: The baby weighs four kilos.

senses.usageNote: 'Weigh' is the verb; 'weight' is the noun. Say 'I weigh 40 kilos', not 'My weigh is 40 kilos'.

senses.definition: a meeting where people learn about a subject by doing activities together

examples.text: I went to a painting workshop at the weekend.

translations.zh: 我周末参加了一个绘画工作坊。

senses.definition: a room or building where things are made or repaired

examples.text: My dad fixes bikes in his workshop.

translations.zh: 我爸爸在他的作坊里修自行车。

senses.definition: unhappy because something was not as good as you hoped

examples.text: I was disappointed with the film.

senses.usageNote: 'Disappointed with/by' a thing; 'disappointed in' a person.

senses.definition: good enough, or allowed

examples.text: Shouting in class is not acceptable.

translations.zh: 在课堂上大喊大叫是不可以的。

senses.definition: correct and exact, with no mistakes

examples.text: This clock is very accurate.

senses.definition: in total; also, completely

examples.text: That's twelve pounds altogether.

senses.usageNote: Don't confuse 'altogether' (in total) with 'all together' (everyone in one group).

senses.definition: to look at something carefully to understand it

examples.text: The scientists analysed the water samples.

senses.usageNote: British spelling is 'analyse'; American spelling is 'analyze'.

senses.definition: the strong feeling you have when you are angry

examples.text: He couldn't hide his anger.

translations.zh: 他掩饰不住自己的怒气。

senses.definition: to act in a certain way, or to act politely

examples.text: The children behaved very well at the museum.

translations.zh: 孩子们在博物馆里表现得很好。

senses.usageNote: 'Behave yourself!' means 'be good and polite'.

senses.definition: a cupboard with shelves or drawers for keeping things

examples.text: The glasses are in the kitchen cabinet.

translations.zh: 玻璃杯在厨房的橱柜里。

senses.definition: to decide that a planned event will not happen

examples.text: The match was cancelled because of snow.

senses.usageNote: British spelling doubles the 'l': cancelled, cancelling.

senses.definition: to use energy, time or goods; also, to eat or drink

examples.text: Old fridges consume a lot of electricity.

senses.definition: a competition

examples.text: He won first prize in a singing contest.

translations.zh: 他在一次歌唱比赛中获得了一等奖。

senses.definition: the ability to do something that frightens you

examples.text: It took courage to ask for help.

senses.definition: a thin line where something is broken but not separated

examples.text: There's a crack in my phone screen.

translations.zh: 我的手机屏幕上有一道裂缝。

senses.definition: how deep something is

examples.text: The pool has a depth of two metres.

senses.definition: wanting or needing something very much

examples.text: After the long walk, we were desperate for a drink.

translations.zh: 走了很长的路后，我们非常想喝点东西。

senses.definition: to make a hole in the ground by moving earth

examples.text: The dog is digging a hole in the garden.

translations.zh: 那只狗正在花园里挖洞。

examples.text: We dug up some potatoes for dinner.
examples.cloze: We {{dug}} up some potatoes for dinner.

translations.zh: 我们挖了些土豆做晚饭。

senses.definition: to give things to a number of people

examples.text: The teacher distributed the test papers.

senses.definition: to control or be the most important or noticeable part of something

examples.text: Our team dominated the whole match.

translations.zh: 我们队主导了整场比赛。

senses.definition: full of energy and new ideas

examples.text: Our new coach is young and dynamic.

translations.zh: 我们的新教练年轻又充满活力。

senses.definition: to think carefully about how good or useful something is

examples.text: The teacher will evaluate each group's project.

translations.zh: 老师会评估每个小组的项目。

senses.definition: to not include someone or something; to keep someone out

examples.text: The price excludes drinks.

senses.definition: to become hard because of cold, or to make food very cold to keep it

examples.text: Water freezes at zero degrees.
The lake froze last winter.
examples.cloze: The lake {{froze}} last winter.

senses.definition: happening often

examples.text: There are frequent buses to the city centre.

translations.zh: 去市中心的公交车很多。

senses.definition: kind and calm; not strong or rough

examples.text: Be gentle with the baby rabbit.

senses.definition: to suggest something without saying it directly

examples.text: Are you implying that I made a mistake?

translations.zh: 你是在暗示我犯了错吗？

senses.usageNote: The speaker 'implies' something; the listener 'infers' it. Don't mix them up.

senses.definition: the way people or things communicate with or affect each other

examples.text: Online lessons have less interaction between students.

translations.zh: 网课中学生之间的互动较少。

senses.definition: very silly or strange; also, informally, very angry or very keen on something

examples.text: My little brother is mad about dinosaurs.

translations.zh: 我弟弟对恐龙非常着迷。

senses.definition: the state of belonging to a club or group

examples.text: My gym membership ends next month.

translations.zh: 我的健身房会员资格下个月到期。

senses.definition: used to add more information; also

examples.text: The hotel was cheap. Moreover, it was near the beach.

translations.zh: 这家酒店很便宜，而且离海滩很近。

senses.usageNote: 'Moreover' is quite formal and is mostly used in writing.

senses.definition: to fill a space or time, or to live in or use a place

examples.text: The toilet is occupied at the moment.
Puzzles keep the children occupied on long journeys.

translations.zh: 拼图能让孩子们在长途旅行中有事可做。

senses.definition: (of a colour) light; (of a face) whiter than usual

examples.text: She painted her room pale blue.

translations.zh: 她把房间刷成了淡蓝色。

examples.text: You look pale. Are you feeling OK?

senses.definition: a number of things put on top of each other

examples.text: There's a pile of books on my desk.

senses.definition: nice, enjoyable or friendly

examples.text: We had a pleasant walk by the river.

translations.zh: 我们在河边愉快地散了步。

senses.definition: a person who writes poems

examples.text: Li Bai is one of China's most famous poets.

translations.zh: 李白是中国最著名的诗人之一。

senses.definition: to have or own something

examples.text: He possesses a great talent for music.

translations.zh: 他拥有很高的音乐天赋。

senses.usageNote: 'Possess' is formal and is not used in continuous tenses: say 'He possesses', not 'He is possessing'.

senses.definition: exact and correct in every detail

examples.text: Can you give me the precise time you arrived?

translations.zh: 你能告诉我你到达的准确时间吗？

senses.definition: to keep something safe or in good condition

examples.text: The town has preserved its old buildings.

translations.zh: 这个小镇保存了它的老建筑。

senses.definition: to feel sorry about something you did or did not do

examples.text: I regret not studying harder for the test.

translations.zh: 我后悔考试前没有更努力地学习。

senses.usageNote: 'Regret doing' is about the past; 'regret to tell you' is a polite way to give bad news.

senses.definition: money you get every month for your job

examples.text: She got a higher salary at her new job.

translations.zh: 她在新工作中拿到了更高的薪水。

senses.usageNote: A 'salary' is usually paid monthly; 'wages' are often paid weekly or by the hour.

senses.definition: soon; in a short time

examples.text: The film will start shortly.

senses.usageNote: 'Shortly' means 'soon', not 'in a short way'. 'Shortly after' means 'soon after'.

senses.definition: to slide by accident and fall or almost fall

examples.text: Be careful not to slip on the wet floor.

translations.zh: 小心别在湿地板上滑倒。

senses.definition: a path through the countryside, especially for walking

examples.text: We followed a trail through the forest.

translations.zh: 我们沿着一条小路穿过了森林。

senses.definition: legally or officially acceptable, and not out of date

examples.text: Your passport must be valid for six months.

translations.zh: 你的护照必须有六个月的有效期。

senses.definition: based on good reasons

examples.text: That's a valid point.

senses.definition: certain to happen and impossible to avoid

examples.text: Forgetting is inevitable — that is why reviews are spaced.

translations.zh: 遗忘不可避免——这正是复习要间隔安排的原因。

senses.definition: worried and nervous about something that might happen

examples.text: He was anxious about the results.

senses.definition: to change something a little so that it works or fits better

examples.text: You can adjust the height of the chair.

translations.zh: 你可以调节椅子的高度。

senses.definition: to move your body forwards or down, or to make something curved

examples.text: Bend your knees when you lift heavy boxes.

translations.zh: 搬重箱子时要弯曲膝盖。

senses.definition: having a strong, sharp taste that is not sweet

examples.text: This coffee tastes very bitter.

senses.definition: feeling angry and upset because something unfair happened

examples.text: He felt bitter about losing the final.

translations.zh: 输掉决赛让他愤愤不平。

senses.definition: a line that marks the edge of an area

examples.text: The river forms the boundary of the farm.

senses.definition: something difficult or worrying that you have to deal with

examples.text: I don't want to be a burden to my friends.

translations.zh: 我不想成为朋友们的负担。

senses.definition: (of music) serious and traditional, such as music by Mozart

examples.text: My dad listens to classical music while he cooks.

translations.zh: 我爸爸做饭时听古典音乐。

senses.definition: to ask someone, or look in a book, for advice or information

examples.text: You should consult a dictionary if you're not sure.

translations.zh: 如果不确定，你应该查一下词典。

senses.definition: easy or useful for you, or near and easy to reach

examples.text: Is Monday a convenient time for you?

translations.zh: 星期一对你来说方便吗？

senses.usageNote: Things are convenient for people, so say 'Is it convenient for you?', not 'Are you convenient?'.

senses.definition: having a strong wish to do something, so that nothing will stop you

examples.text: She was determined to finish the race.

senses.definition: to decide that something is not important; to allow people to leave

examples.text: The teacher dismissed the class early on Friday.

translations.zh: 星期五老师提前让全班下课了。

senses.definition: very small pieces of dirt that cover surfaces

examples.text: The old books were covered in dust.

translations.zh: 那些旧书上落满了灰尘。

senses.definition: to develop and change slowly over time

examples.text: Birds evolved from dinosaurs millions of years ago.

translations.zh: 鸟类是在数百万年前由恐龙进化而来的。

senses.definition: the equipment or clothes you need for an activity

examples.text: Don't forget your swimming gear.

senses.usageNote: In this meaning 'gear' is uncountable: 'camping gear', not 'gears'.

senses.definition: the ability to find things funny, or the funny side of something

examples.text: My dad has a great sense of humour.

senses.usageNote: British spelling 'humour'; the adjective is 'humorous' (no u after o).

senses.definition: to force people to accept a rule, tax or punishment

examples.text: The city imposed a speed limit near the school.

translations.zh: 市政府在学校附近实行了限速。

senses.definition: to put equipment or software in place so it is ready to use

examples.text: I installed a new game on my tablet.

translations.zh: 我在平板电脑上安装了一个新游戏。

senses.definition: to hit a door or window to get attention, or to hit something by accident

examples.text: Please knock before you come in.

senses.definition: something made by combining different things

examples.text: Pour the mixture into a cake tin.

translations.zh: 把混合好的面糊倒进蛋糕模具里。

senses.definition: to say that someone or something is very good

examples.text: The teacher praised her for her hard work.

senses.usageNote: We 'praise someone for something'. As a noun, 'praise' is uncountable: 'a lot of praise'.

senses.definition: an exam you have passed or a course you have finished

examples.text: You need a teaching qualification to work here.

translations.zh: 在这里工作需要教师资格证。

senses.definition: far away from towns and other people

examples.text: They live in a remote village in the mountains.

translations.zh: 他们住在山里一个偏远的村子。

senses.definition: completely flat and even, with no rough parts

examples.text: The baby's skin is so smooth.

senses.definition: happening without problems

examples.text: We had a smooth flight.

translations.zh: 我们的航班很平稳顺利。

senses.definition: to deal successfully with a difficult situation

examples.text: He's coping well with the pressure.

senses.usageNote: 'Cope with'. Used intransitively otherwise: 'I can't cope.'

senses.definition: to say that someone has done something wrong

examples.text: She accused her brother of eating her cake.

translations.zh: 她指责弟弟吃了她的蛋糕。

senses.usageNote: The pattern is 'accuse someone of doing something', not 'accuse someone for'.

senses.definition: something that stops people from going somewhere or doing something

examples.text: Language can be a barrier to making friends.

translations.zh: 语言可能成为交朋友的障碍。

grammarNotes.irregularForms: break down · broke down · broken down

senses.definition: (of a machine or vehicle) to stop working

examples.text: I hope the bus doesn't break down again.

translations.zh: 希望公交车别再抛锚了。

examples.cloze: I hope the bus doesn't {{break down}} again.

senses.definition: a special event or party for something happy

examples.text: There was a big celebration after the final.

translations.zh: 决赛后举行了盛大的庆祝活动。

grammarNotes.irregularForms: come up with · came up with · come up with

senses.definition: to think of an idea, plan or answer

examples.text: Can you come up with a name for our team?

translations.zh: 你能给我们队想个名字吗？

examples.cloze: Can you {{come up with}} a name for our team?

senses.definition: a hard building material made from cement, sand and water

examples.text: The path is made of concrete.

translations.zh: 这条小路是混凝土铺的。

senses.definition: real and clear, not just an idea

examples.text: Can you give me a concrete example?

translations.zh: 你能给我一个具体的例子吗？

senses.definition: something that makes an illness go away

examples.text: There is still no cure for the common cold.

translations.zh: 普通感冒至今仍无法根治。

senses.definition: to become less in size or number, or to make something less

examples.text: The price of the tickets decreased last month.

senses.usageNote: As a verb the stress is on the second syllable (deCREASE); as a noun it is on the first (DEcrease).

senses.definition: the act of destroying something, or the damage caused

examples.text: The destruction of rainforests harms many animals.

translations.zh: 雨林遭到破坏伤害了许多动物。

senses.definition: to see or understand the difference between two things

examples.text: Can you distinguish between the twins?

translations.zh: 你能分辨出这对双胞胎吗？

senses.usageNote: Common patterns: 'distinguish A from B' or 'distinguish between A and B'.

senses.definition: having skill or knowledge because you have done something many times

examples.text: We had an experienced guide on the mountain walk.

translations.zh: 我们登山时有一位经验丰富的向导。

senses.definition: to become well or happy again after an illness or a sad time

examples.text: It took me a week to get over my cold.

translations.zh: 我花了一个星期才从感冒中恢复过来。

examples.cloze: It took me a week to {{get over}} my cold.

senses.definition: the seeds of plants like rice and wheat; a very small piece of something

examples.text: There's a grain of sand in my shoe.

senses.definition: the main office of a company or organisation

examples.text: The company's headquarters are in London.

translations.zh: 这家公司的总部在伦敦。

senses.usageNote: 'Headquarters' always ends in -s, and can take a singular or plural verb.

senses.definition: important in history

translations.zh: 有历史意义的；历史性的

examples.text: We visited the historic castle on the hill.

translations.zh: 我们参观了山上那座历史悠久的城堡。

senses.usageNote: 'Historic' = important in history; 'historical' = about or from the past.

senses.definition: used to say what you hope will happen

examples.text: Hopefully, we'll arrive before lunch.

translations.zh: 希望我们能在午饭前到。

senses.definition: to bring goods into a country from another country to sell

examples.text: The UK imports a lot of fruit from Spain.

translations.zh: 英国从西班牙进口大量水果。

senses.definition: not guilty of doing something wrong

examples.text: The dog looked innocent, but the biscuits had disappeared.

translations.zh: 那只狗看起来很无辜，可是饼干不见了。

senses.definition: an official document that gives you permission to do or own something

examples.text: My brother has just got his driving licence.

senses.usageNote: In British English the noun is 'licence' and the verb is 'license'.

senses.definition: not tight or not firmly fixed

examples.text: I have a loose tooth.

senses.usageNote: Don't confuse 'loose' /luːs/ (not tight) with 'lose' /luːz/ (not have any more).

senses.definition: a feeling of being upset by rude words; also an illegal act

examples.text: No offence, but I don't like your song.

translations.zh: 无意冒犯，但我不喜欢你的歌。

senses.usageNote: 'Take offence' means to feel upset by something someone says.

senses.definition: to succeed in dealing with a problem or difficulty

examples.text: She worked hard to overcome her fear of water.

translations.zh: 她努力克服了对水的恐惧。

senses.definition: poems as a type of writing

examples.text: We read some English poetry in class today.

translations.zh: 今天我们在课上读了一些英文诗歌。

senses.usageNote: 'Poetry' is uncountable. For one piece, say 'a poem', not 'a poetry'.

senses.definition: to act as if something is true when it is not

examples.text: The children pretended to be pirates.

translations.zh: 孩子们假装自己是海盗。

senses.usageNote: We say 'pretend to do something' or 'pretend that...'. It does not mean 'intend'.

senses.definition: not cooked

examples.text: You can eat carrots raw or cooked.

translations.zh: 胡萝卜可以生吃也可以煮熟吃。

senses.definition: in its natural state, before being changed or used

examples.text: The factory buys raw materials such as cotton.

translations.zh: 这家工厂采购棉花等原材料。

senses.definition: to save someone or something from a dangerous situation

examples.text: Firefighters rescued a cat from the tree.

translations.zh: 消防员把一只猫从树上救了下来。

senses.definition: pleased because you got what you wanted

examples.text: Are you satisfied with your test score?

translations.zh: 你对自己的考试成绩满意吗？

senses.usageNote: Use 'satisfied with', not 'satisfied about'. Don't confuse with 'satisfying' (making you feel satisfied).

senses.definition: to try to deal with a difficult problem

examples.text: The town is trying to tackle its traffic problem.

translations.zh: 这个城镇正努力解决交通问题。

senses.definition: to start doing something that someone else was doing

examples.text: Can you take over the cooking while I answer the phone?

translations.zh: 我接个电话，你能接着做饭吗？

examples.cloze: Can you {{take over}} the cooking while I answer the phone?

senses.definition: to change words from one language into another

examples.text: Can you translate this sentence into Chinese?

translations.zh: 你能把这个句子翻译成中文吗？

senses.usageNote: Use 'translate from X into Y'.

senses.definition: surprising because you did not think it would happen

examples.text: We had an unexpected visit from my aunt.

senses.definition: to speak very quietly

examples.text: She whispered the answer to her friend.

translations.zh: 她小声把答案告诉了朋友。

senses.definition: to change your behaviour to fit a new situation

examples.text: It took her a few weeks to adapt to the new school.

translations.zh: 她花了几周时间适应新学校。

senses.usageNote: Don't confuse 'adapt' (change to fit) with 'adopt' (take and use as your own).

senses.definition: a list of things to talk about at a meeting

examples.text: The first item on the agenda is the school trip.

translations.zh: 议程上的第一项是学校旅行。

senses.definition: to change something, usually a little

examples.text: We had to alter our plans because of the rain.

translations.zh: 因为下雨，我们不得不改变计划。

senses.definition: an interesting place or thing that people visit

examples.text: The castle is the town's main tourist attraction.

translations.zh: 城堡是这个镇的主要旅游景点。

senses.definition: for a short time, or in a few words

examples.text: Let me briefly explain the rules.

translations.zh: 让我简单解释一下规则。

senses.definition: to run after someone or something to catch them

examples.text: The puppy chased the ball across the garden.

senses.definition: a place where people go to see a doctor or get medical advice

examples.text: I took my little brother to the clinic.

senses.definition: to make someone unable to understand clearly; also, to mix up two things

examples.text: People often confuse me with my twin brother.

translations.zh: 人们常把我和我的双胞胎弟弟搞混。

senses.definition: noticing or knowing about something; also, awake

examples.text: She was conscious of everyone looking at her.

translations.zh: 她意识到大家都在看她。

senses.definition: causing a lot of disagreement

examples.text: The referee made a controversial decision.

translations.zh: 裁判做出了一个有争议的判罚。

senses.definition: good enough or of an acceptable standard

examples.text: We finally found a decent place to eat.

translations.zh: 我们终于找到一个不错的吃饭地方。

senses.definition: a measurement of length, width or height

examples.text: Write down the dimensions of the table before you buy it.

translations.zh: 买桌子之前先记下它的尺寸。

senses.definition: old (a polite word for people)

examples.text: We help an elderly neighbour with her shopping.

translations.zh: 我们帮一位年长的邻居买东西。

senses.usageNote: 'Elderly' is more polite than 'old' when talking about people. 'The elderly' means old people in general.

senses.definition: to want to have or do something (informal, British)

examples.text: Do you fancy going to the cinema tonight?

senses.usageNote: After 'fancy' use the -ing form: 'Do you fancy going...?', not 'fancy to go'.

senses.definition: decorated or expensive-looking; not simple

examples.text: We had dinner at a fancy restaurant.

translations.zh: 我们在一家高档餐厅吃了晚饭。

senses.definition: to do what is needed or hoped for

examples.text: She fulfilled her dream of visiting Paris.

translations.zh: 她实现了游览巴黎的梦想。

senses.usageNote: British spelling is 'fulfil' (fulfilled, fulfilling); American is 'fulfill'.

senses.definition: feeling or showing thanks

examples.text: I'm very grateful for your help.

senses.usageNote: Use 'grateful to someone for something': 'I'm grateful to you for your advice.'

senses.definition: advice or a rule about how to do something

examples.text: Follow the safety guidelines when using the lab.

translations.zh: 使用实验室时要遵守安全准则。

senses.definition: the history, buildings and traditions of a country or group

examples.text: The Great Wall is part of China's heritage.

translations.zh: 长城是中国遗产的一部分。

senses.definition: so good or big that people admire it

translations.zh: 令人印象深刻的；了不起的

examples.text: The view from the top of the mountain was impressive.

senses.definition: a general rise in prices over time

examples.text: Because of inflation, bread costs more than last year.

translations.zh: 由于通货膨胀，面包比去年贵了。

senses.definition: able to learn and understand things quickly

examples.text: Dolphins are very intelligent animals.

translations.zh: 海豚是非常聪明的动物。

senses.definition: to explain or decide what something means; to translate what someone says

examples.text: How do you interpret the ending of the story?

translations.zh: 你怎么理解这个故事的结局？

senses.definition: a talk to a group of people about a subject, especially at university

examples.text: We went to a lecture about space travel.

translations.zh: 我们去听了一场关于太空旅行的讲座。

senses.usageNote: We 'give' or 'attend' a lecture 'on' or 'about' a subject.

senses.definition: a substance, like water or oil, that flows and is not solid or a gas

examples.text: You can't take liquids over 100 ml on the plane.

translations.zh: 你不能带超过100毫升的液体上飞机。

senses.definition: to move your head down and up to say yes or hello

examples.text: She nodded to show she understood.

senses.definition: something you must do because of a rule, promise or duty

examples.text: You are under no obligation to buy anything.

translations.zh: 你没有义务买任何东西。

senses.definition: in or to a foreign country, especially across the sea

examples.text: My cousin is studying overseas this year.

translations.zh: 我表姐今年在海外留学。

senses.usageNote: Don't say 'go to overseas'. Say 'go overseas' or 'go abroad'.

senses.definition: a painting, drawing or photo of a person

examples.text: The artist painted a portrait of my grandmother.

translations.zh: 画家为我奶奶画了一幅肖像。

senses.definition: something that you say that gives an opinion

examples.text: He made a funny remark about my hat.

translations.zh: 他对我的帽子说了句好笑的话。

senses.definition: to stop working because you have reached a certain age

examples.text: My grandfather retired when he was sixty.

translations.zh: 我爷爷六十岁时退休了。

senses.definition: a way of behaving that is likely to happen often

examples.text: He has a tendency to talk too fast.

senses.definition: enough or good enough for a purpose

examples.text: Make sure you get adequate sleep before the exam.

translations.zh: 考试前一定要保证充足的睡眠。

senses.definition: by itself, or without thinking about it

examples.text: The lights turn off automatically at night.

senses.definition: to help something increase or improve

examples.text: Winning the game boosted the team's confidence.

translations.zh: 赢得比赛提升了球队的信心。

senses.definition: going on without stopping

examples.text: We had three days of continuous rain.

translations.zh: 我们这里连续下了三天雨。

senses.definition: a traditional way of doing something in a society

examples.text: It's a custom to give red envelopes at New Year.

translations.zh: 新年发红包是一种习俗。

senses.usageNote: 'Customs' (plural) is also the place at an airport or border where your bags are checked.

senses.definition: needing someone or something for help or support

examples.text: Young children are dependent on their parents.

senses.definition: far away in space or time

examples.text: We could hear distant thunder.

translations.zh: 我们能听到远处的雷声。

senses.definition: a question you ask to get information

examples.text: For enquiries, please call the front desk.

senses.usageNote: British English often uses 'enquiry' for a question and 'inquiry' for an official investigation.

senses.definition: to stop being angry with someone for something they did

examples.text: Please forgive me for being late.

senses.usageNote: Pattern: 'forgive someone for doing something'.

senses.definition: also; used to add another point

examples.text: The hotel was clean. Furthermore, the staff were very kind.

translations.zh: 酒店很干净。而且，员工也非常友善。

senses.definition: happy to give money, time or help to others

examples.text: It was generous of you to share your lunch.

translations.zh: 你把午饭分给别人，真大方。

senses.definition: a new idea, method or invention, or the use of new ideas

examples.text: The company is famous for its innovation in design.

translations.zh: 这家公司以设计创新而闻名。

senses.definition: very strong or extreme

examples.text: The heat in the desert was intense.

senses.definition: younger, or lower in position or rank

examples.text: He plays for the junior football team.

translations.zh: 他在青少年足球队踢球。

senses.definition: a narrow road in the country, or one part of a wide road

examples.text: We walked down a quiet country lane.

translations.zh: 我们沿着一条安静的乡间小路走。

senses.definition: causing pain

examples.text: My ankle is still painful after the fall.

translations.zh: 摔倒后我的脚踝还在疼。

senses.definition: a feeling of liking one thing more than another

examples.text: Do you have a preference for tea or coffee?

senses.definition: a person or group you are competing against

examples.text: The two schools have been rivals in football for years.

translations.zh: 这两所学校多年来一直是足球场上的对手。

senses.definition: connected with the countryside, not towns

examples.text: Life in rural areas is quieter than in big cities.

translations.zh: 农村的生活比大城市安静。

senses.definition: to make someone pleased by giving them what they want or need

examples.text: It's hard to satisfy every customer.

translations.zh: 很难让每位顾客都满意。

senses.definition: to turn something round, or to bend it into a new shape

examples.text: Twist the lid to open the jar.

senses.definition: an unexpected change in a story

examples.text: The story has a surprising twist at the end.

translations.zh: 这个故事结尾有个出人意料的转折。

senses.definition: to agree to do or start a piece of work

examples.text: The students will undertake a science project this term.

translations.zh: 学生们这学期将开展一个科学项目。

senses.definition: to pause before doing something because you are unsure

examples.text: She hesitated before answering.

senses.usageNote: A long hesitation before recalling a word is exactly what 'Hard' means when you rate a card.

senses.definition: to respect or like someone or something very much

examples.text: I really admire my grandmother's patience.

translations.zh: 我非常钦佩奶奶的耐心。

senses.definition: working by itself without a person controlling it

examples.text: The shop has automatic doors.

senses.definition: to send out a programme on TV or radio

examples.text: The match will be broadcast live tonight.

senses.definition: a group of things of the same kind held or growing together

examples.text: She bought a bunch of flowers for her mum.

senses.definition: to break open suddenly, or to start doing something suddenly

examples.text: The balloon burst with a loud bang.

senses.usageNote: 'Burst into tears' and 'burst out laughing' mean to suddenly start crying or laughing.

senses.definition: a box, bottle or similar object used to hold things

examples.text: Put the leftovers in a plastic container.

translations.zh: 把剩菜放进塑料容器里。

senses.definition: the place where someone or something is going

examples.text: We reached our destination just before dark.

translations.zh: 我们在天黑前到达了目的地。

senses.definition: to have a different opinion from someone

examples.text: I disagree with you about the ending of the book.

translations.zh: 关于这本书的结局，我和你意见不同。

senses.usageNote: Say 'I disagree with you', not 'I am disagree'.

senses.definition: a strong feeling of interest and excitement

examples.text: She has great enthusiasm for science.

senses.definition: to be more than a certain number or amount

examples.text: Your bag must not exceed twenty kilos.

translations.zh: 你的包不得超过二十公斤。

senses.definition: to write information in the spaces on a form

examples.text: Please fill in this form with your details.

translations.zh: 请在这张表上填写你的详细信息。

examples.cloze: Please {{fill in}} this form with your details.

senses.usageNote: British English says 'fill in a form'; American English often says 'fill out a form'.

senses.definition: to bend paper or cloth so that one part lies on top of another

examples.text: Fold the paper in half to make a card.

translations.zh: 把纸对折做成一张卡片。

senses.definition: luckily; used to say something good happened

examples.text: Fortunately, nobody was hurt.

senses.definition: a movement of the hands or head to show meaning

examples.text: She made a gesture to tell us to be quiet.

translations.zh: 她做了个手势让我们安静。

senses.definition: to look at something quickly

examples.text: She glanced at the clock and ran out.

translations.zh: 她瞥了一眼时钟就跑了出去。

senses.usageNote: 'At a glance' means with one quick look.

senses.definition: to give someone the wish or ideas to do something

examples.text: Her teacher inspired her to become a scientist.

translations.zh: 她的老师激励她成为一名科学家。

senses.definition: to give a good reason for something

examples.text: Can you justify spending so much on a phone?

translations.zh: 你能说出花这么多钱买手机的正当理由吗？

senses.definition: great comfort, or something expensive that you enjoy but do not need

examples.text: A hot bath after a long walk is a real luxury.

translations.zh: 走了很远的路后泡个热水澡真是一种享受。

senses.definition: the wish or reason to do something

examples.text: I've lost my motivation to practise the piano.

translations.zh: 我已经没有练钢琴的动力了。

senses.definition: something that is done to a person because they did something wrong

examples.text: As a punishment, she couldn't watch TV for a week.

translations.zh: 作为惩罚，她一周不能看电视。

senses.definition: happening or moving very fast

examples.text: The city has seen rapid growth in the last ten years.

translations.zh: 这座城市在过去十年里发展迅速。

senses.definition: feeling afraid

examples.text: My little sister is scared of the dark.

senses.usageNote: Use 'scared of something': 'scared of dogs', not 'scared with dogs'.

senses.definition: the act of keeping things somewhere until you need them, or the space for this

examples.text: My phone doesn't have enough storage for more photos.

translations.zh: 我的手机没有足够的存储空间存更多照片了。

senses.definition: a person you do not know

examples.text: Never get into a car with a stranger.

translations.zh: 千万不要上陌生人的车。

senses.usageNote: 'Stranger' is a person you don't know, not someone from another country (that is a 'foreigner').

senses.definition: making sure that rules are always obeyed

examples.text: Our maths teacher is strict but fair.

translations.zh: 我们的数学老师严格但公正。

senses.usageNote: Use 'strict with someone' and 'strict about something'.

senses.definition: a device that controls the flow of water from a pipe

examples.text: Turn off the tap while you brush your teeth.

senses.usageNote: British 'tap' = American 'faucet'.

senses.definition: to touch something quickly and lightly

examples.text: Tap the screen to start the game.

senses.definition: a series of musical notes that make a pleasant sound

examples.text: She was humming a happy tune.

translations.zh: 她哼着一首欢快的曲子。

senses.definition: able to make good decisions because of knowledge and experience

examples.text: It was wise to leave early because of the traffic.

translations.zh: 因为交通拥堵，早点出发是明智的。

senses.definition: to go somewhere with someone

examples.text: Children must be accompanied by an adult.

senses.usageNote: Do not add 'with': say 'accompany someone', not 'accompany with someone'.

senses.definition: behaving in an angry way, ready to fight or argue

examples.text: That dog can be aggressive towards strangers.

translations.zh: 那条狗对陌生人可能有攻击性。

senses.definition: a small object that stores electricity to power things

examples.text: My phone battery is almost empty.

senses.definition: to put something in the ground and cover it

examples.text: The dog buried its bone in the garden.

translations.zh: 狗把骨头埋在了花园里。

senses.definition: a first payment you make so that something is kept for you

examples.text: We paid a small deposit to book the room.

translations.zh: 我们付了一小笔定金来预订房间。

senses.definition: a conversation in a book, play or film, or between two people

examples.text: Practise the dialogue with your partner.

translations.zh: 和你的搭档练习这段对话。

senses.definition: including many different kinds of people or things

examples.text: The city has a diverse mix of restaurants.

translations.zh: 这座城市有各种各样的餐馆。

senses.definition: to pull something heavy along the ground

examples.text: He dragged his heavy suitcase up the stairs.

translations.zh: 他把沉重的行李箱拖上了楼梯。

senses.definition: the state of being healthy and strong

examples.text: Cycling to school is good for your fitness.

translations.zh: 骑车上学对你的身体健康有好处。

senses.definition: to stay on the top of water or move slowly through the air

examples.text: The leaves floated down the river.

senses.definition: to hold something very tightly

examples.text: Grip the rope with both hands.

senses.definition: very unpleasant or bad

examples.text: This medicine tastes horrible.

senses.definition: to explain something by giving examples, or to add pictures to a book

examples.text: The teacher illustrated her point with a simple drawing.

translations.zh: 老师用一幅简单的画来说明她的观点。

examples.text: This children's book is beautifully illustrated.

translations.zh: 这本童书的插图非常精美。

senses.definition: a clear, deep understanding of something

examples.text: The documentary gives us an insight into life under the sea.

translations.zh: 这部纪录片让我们深入了解海底的生活。

senses.definition: to bend your body in a direction, or to rest against something

examples.text: Don't lean out of the window.
He leaned his bike against the wall.

senses.definition: a size, length or amount found by measuring

examples.text: Take the measurements of the window before buying curtains.

translations.zh: 买窗帘前先量一下窗户的尺寸。

senses.definition: extremely good

examples.text: She gave an outstanding performance in the school play.

translations.zh: 她在学校话剧中表现得非常出色。

senses.definition: to notice something, or to understand or think of something in a particular way

examples.text: Cats perceive colours differently from humans.

translations.zh: 猫对颜色的感知和人类不同。

senses.definition: to shout in a loud, high voice because you are afraid, excited or hurt

examples.text: The kids screamed with joy on the roller coaster.

translations.zh: 孩子们坐过山车时兴奋得尖叫。

senses.definition: a place that protects you from bad weather or danger

examples.text: We took shelter from the rain under a bridge.

senses.definition: annoyed because you cannot do or change something

examples.text: I get frustrated when I forget words I knew yesterday.

translations.zh: 昨天还记得的词今天忘了，我就很沮丧。

senses.definition: a loud sound or device that warns people or wakes them up

examples.text: I set my alarm for seven o'clock.

senses.definition: an official statement that gives people information

examples.text: Please listen to the announcement about our train.

translations.zh: 请听关于我们列车的广播通知。

senses.usageNote: We usually 'make an announcement', not 'do an announcement'.

grammarNotes.irregularForms: catch up · caught up · caught up

senses.definition: to reach someone who is ahead of you, or to do work you missed

examples.text: I was ill last week, so I need to catch up.

translations.zh: 我上周生病了，所以得把功课补上。

examples.cloze: I was ill last week, so I need to {{catch up}}.

senses.usageNote: Use 'catch up with someone': 'Walk slowly so I can catch up with you.'

senses.definition: the protection of nature, animals and old buildings

examples.text: She works in wildlife conservation.

translations.zh: 她从事野生动物保护工作。

senses.definition: completely sure that something is true

examples.text: I'm convinced that I left my keys at school.

translations.zh: 我确信我把钥匙落在学校了。

senses.definition: a person whose job is to find out facts and solve mysteries

examples.text: The detective found the missing painting in the attic.

translations.zh: 侦探在阁楼里找到了丢失的画。

senses.definition: to slowly become less bright, strong or loud

examples.text: My jeans have faded after many washes.

translations.zh: 我的牛仔裤洗了很多次后褪色了。

senses.definition: to say hello to someone when you meet them

examples.text: Our dog greets us at the door every day.

translations.zh: 我们的狗每天都在门口迎接我们。

senses.definition: to spend time relaxing somewhere or with someone (informal)

examples.text: We often hang out at the park after school.

translations.zh: 放学后我们经常在公园玩。

examples.cloze: We often {{hang out}} at the park after school.

senses.definition: unkind, cruel or too strong; very difficult to live in

examples.text: Few plants can survive the harsh winters there.

translations.zh: 很少有植物能熬过那里严酷的冬天。

senses.definition: to become healthy again, or to make someone or something healthy

examples.text: The cut on my knee healed quickly.

translations.zh: 我膝盖上的伤口很快就愈合了。

senses.definition: to make goods in large numbers, usually in a factory

examples.text: This factory manufactures bicycles.

senses.definition: not talking much about your own skills or success; also not large

examples.text: She is very modest about her prizes.

translations.zh: 她对自己获得的奖项很谦虚。

senses.definition: (of food) grown without artificial chemicals

examples.text: We buy organic vegetables from the local farm.

translations.zh: 我们从当地农场买有机蔬菜。

senses.definition: the main facts or ideas without details; also the shape of something

examples.text: Write an outline of your story before you start.

translations.zh: 动笔之前先写下故事的大纲。

senses.definition: quiet and calm

examples.text: The lake is very peaceful early in the morning.

senses.definition: to damage or spoil something completely

examples.text: The rain ruined our picnic.

translations.zh: 这场雨毁了我们的野餐。

senses.definition: the broken parts that are left of an old building

examples.text: We visited the ruins of an old castle.

translations.zh: 我们参观了一座古城堡的遗迹。

senses.definition: giving up something you want so that you or others can have something more important

examples.text: Her parents made many sacrifices so she could study abroad.

translations.zh: 她的父母为了让她出国留学作出了很多牺牲。

senses.definition: to deal with a problem, or to put things in order

examples.text: I need to sort out my clothes before the trip.

translations.zh: 旅行前我需要整理一下衣服。

examples.cloze: I need to {{sort out}} my clothes before the trip.

senses.definition: the hot gas that water becomes when it boils

examples.text: Steam was rising from the hot soup.

senses.definition: to cook food using steam

examples.text: My mum steams fish with ginger.

senses.definition: the business of providing hotels, trips, etc. for people on holiday

examples.text: Tourism is important for the island.

translations.zh: 旅游业对这个岛很重要。

senses.definition: a very sad event, or a serious play with a sad ending

examples.text: We read a famous tragedy in English class.

translations.zh: 我们在英语课上读了一部著名的悲剧。

senses.definition: to make a machine quieter or lower; to say no to an offer

examples.text: Please turn down the music — the baby is sleeping.

translations.zh: 请把音乐调小点，宝宝在睡觉。

examples.cloze: Please {{turn down}} the music — the baby is sleeping.

senses.definition: to arrive, often without warning; to make a machine louder

examples.text: I hope more people turn up for the meeting this time.

translations.zh: 希望这次有更多人来参加会议。

examples.cloze: I hope more people {{turn up}} for the meeting this time.

senses.definition: not sure, or not decided

examples.text: The date of the match is still uncertain.

senses.definition: needing to be dealt with immediately

examples.text: I have an urgent message for your mum.

translations.zh: 我有一条紧急消息要告诉你妈妈。

senses.definition: to walk slowly with no special purpose or direction

examples.text: We wandered around the old town all afternoon.

translations.zh: 我们整个下午都在老城区闲逛。

senses.usageNote: Don't confuse 'wander' /ˈwɒndə/ (walk around) with 'wonder' /ˈwʌndə/ (ask yourself).

senses.definition: a fault or something that is not good about someone or something

examples.text: Spelling is my biggest weakness in English.

translations.zh: 拼写是我英语中最大的弱点。

senses.definition: very strange and unusual

examples.text: I heard a weird noise in the kitchen.

translations.zh: 我听到厨房里有奇怪的声音。

senses.usageNote: Spelling: 'weird' breaks the 'i before e' rule.

senses.definition: to clean or dry something by moving a cloth over it

examples.text: Please wipe the table after dinner.

translations.zh: 晚饭后请把桌子擦一下。

senses.definition: everywhere in the world

examples.text: The game is played by millions of people worldwide.

translations.zh: 全世界有数百万人玩这个游戏。

senses.definition: an official paper that shows something is true, such as passing a course

examples.text: Everyone who finishes the course gets a certificate.

translations.zh: 完成课程的每个人都会获得证书。

senses.definition: a small house, usually in the countryside

examples.text: We rented a cottage by the lake.

translations.zh: 我们在湖边租了一间小屋。

senses.definition: working very hard at something because you think it is important

examples.text: She is a dedicated swimmer who trains every morning.

translations.zh: 她是一名很投入的游泳运动员，每天早上都训练。

senses.definition: to interrupt someone or make noise when they are busy or resting

examples.text: Please don't disturb Grandma. She's sleeping.

translations.zh: 请别打扰奶奶，她在睡觉。

senses.definition: extremely interesting

examples.text: The history of writing systems is fascinating.

translations.zh: 文字系统的历史非常有趣。

senses.definition: comments about how good or useful something is

examples.text: The teacher gave me useful feedback on my essay.

translations.zh: 老师对我的作文给出了有用的反馈。

senses.usageNote: 'Feedback' is uncountable: 'some feedback', 'a piece of feedback', not 'a feedback'.

senses.definition: a small piece of help to find an answer

examples.text: Can you give me a hint? I can't guess it.

translations.zh: 你能给我一点提示吗？我猜不出来。

senses.definition: the sound or act of laughing

examples.text: The room was full of laughter.

senses.definition: still happening or continuing

examples.text: The repairs to the bridge are ongoing.

translations.zh: 桥梁的维修工作仍在进行中。

senses.definition: happening or used outside, not in a building

examples.text: The hotel has an outdoor swimming pool.

translations.zh: 这家酒店有一个室外游泳池。

senses.usageNote: 'Outdoor' comes before a noun; 'outdoors' is the adverb: 'We played outdoors.'

senses.definition: a situation that makes you feel sorry or disappointed

examples.text: It's a shame you can't come to the party.

translations.zh: 你不能来参加聚会真遗憾。

senses.usageNote: 'What a shame!' / 'It's a shame' means 'What a pity!' — it is not always about feeling guilty.

senses.definition: permission to enter a place, or the price you pay to go in

examples.text: Admission to the museum is free on Sundays.

senses.definition: a strong wish to do or become something

examples.text: Her ambition is to become a pilot.

translations.zh: 她的志向是成为一名飞行员。

senses.definition: the design of buildings, or the study of designing them

examples.text: I love the old architecture in this city.

translations.zh: 我很喜欢这座城市的古老建筑。

senses.definition: a piece of work that someone is given to do

examples.text: I have to finish my history assignment tonight.

translations.zh: 我今晚得完成历史作业。

senses.definition: with nothing written or printed on it

examples.text: Write your answers in the blank spaces.

senses.definition: brave and willing to take risks; also, very clear and strong in colour or shape

examples.text: It was a bold idea to start her own business.

translations.zh: 她自己创业是个大胆的想法。

senses.definition: great care to avoid danger or mistakes

examples.text: Use caution when crossing busy roads.

translations.zh: 过繁忙的马路时要小心。

senses.definition: a famous person, especially in films, music or TV

examples.text: A celebrity opened the new shopping centre.

translations.zh: 一位名人为新购物中心揭幕。

senses.definition: a situation with no order, where everything is confused

examples.text: The snow caused chaos on the roads.

senses.usageNote: 'Chaos' is uncountable and starts with a /k/ sound.

senses.definition: a piece of information that helps you solve a problem or mystery

examples.text: Can you give me a clue to the answer?

translations.zh: 你能给我一点答案的提示吗？

senses.usageNote: 'I have no clue' is an informal way to say 'I don't know'.

senses.definition: as a result

examples.text: It snowed all night. Consequently, the school was closed.

translations.zh: 下了一整夜的雪，因此学校停课了。

senses.definition: a line or shape that bends smoothly

examples.text: Drive slowly around the curve in the road.

translations.zh: 在路的弯道处要慢慢开。

senses.definition: a large amount of information stored on a computer in an organised way

examples.text: The library keeps all its books in a database.

translations.zh: 图书馆把所有图书都存在一个数据库里。

senses.definition: to give a lot of your time or energy to something

examples.text: He devotes his weekends to looking after the garden.

translations.zh: 他把周末都用来打理花园。

senses.usageNote: 'Devote ... to' is followed by a noun or -ing form: 'devote time to reading'.

senses.definition: to correct and change writing, a film or photos before it is finished

examples.text: She edited the video before posting it.

translations.zh: 她在发布视频之前先剪辑了一下。

senses.definition: the state of being known by many people

examples.text: The singer found fame at the age of sixteen.

translations.zh: 这位歌手十六岁时就成名了。

senses.definition: strong and powerful, sometimes in a frightening way

examples.text: There was fierce competition for the prize.

translations.zh: 这个奖项的竞争非常激烈。

senses.definition: a statement about what will probably happen, especially with the weather

examples.text: The weather forecast says it will snow tomorrow.

translations.zh: 天气预报说明天会下雪。

senses.definition: a safe area of water near land where boats stay

examples.text: The fishing boats came back into the harbour.

senses.definition: a person who comes to live in a country from another country

examples.text: Her grandparents were immigrants who opened a small bakery.

translations.zh: 她的祖父母是移民，开了一家小面包店。

senses.usageNote: An 'immigrant' comes into a country; an 'emigrant' leaves a country. Both can describe the same person.

senses.definition: the way a person or group lives

examples.text: Eating well is part of a healthy lifestyle.

translations.zh: 好好吃饭是健康生活方式的一部分。

senses.definition: not strong or severe; (of weather) not very cold

examples.text: We had a mild winter this year.
I'd like a mild curry, not a hot one.

translations.zh: 我想要不辣的咖喱，不要辣的。

senses.definition: to discuss something in order to reach an agreement

examples.text: We negotiated a later bedtime with our parents.

translations.zh: 我们和父母商量好了晚一点睡觉。

senses.definition: a job or profession

examples.text: Please write your name and occupation on the form.

translations.zh: 请在表格上填写你的姓名和职业。

senses.definition: a gas in the air that people, animals and plants need to live

examples.text: Plants produce oxygen during the day.

senses.definition: how likely something is to happen

examples.text: The probability of rain today is low.

translations.zh: 今天下雨的可能性很低。

senses.definition: to make someone suffer because they have done something wrong

examples.text: He was punished for being rude to the teacher.

translations.zh: 他因对老师无礼而受到惩罚。

senses.definition: an area that is darker and cooler because the sun cannot reach it

examples.text: Let's sit in the shade of that tree.

translations.zh: 我们坐在那棵树的树荫下吧。

senses.usageNote: 'Shade' is a cool area; 'shadow' is the dark shape made by an object.

senses.definition: a type of a colour

examples.text: I like this shade of blue.

senses.definition: a long passage under the ground or through a hill

examples.text: The train went through a long tunnel.

translations.zh: 火车穿过了一条长长的隧道。

senses.definition: having a lot of money

examples.text: The library was built by a wealthy businessman.

translations.zh: 这座图书馆是一位富商建的。

senses.definition: a place to live or stay, such as a room or flat

examples.text: The price includes flights and accommodation.

senses.usageNote: In British English 'accommodation' is uncountable: say 'find accommodation', not 'find an accommodation'. Note the double 'c' and double 'm'.

senses.definition: awake and quick to notice things

examples.text: Drivers must stay alert on long journeys.

translations.zh: 长途驾驶时司机必须保持警觉。

senses.definition: a long seat for two or more people

examples.text: We sat on a bench in the park.

translations.zh: 我们坐在公园的长椅上。

senses.definition: in a way that is planned and not by accident

examples.text: He left the door open deliberately so the cat could come in.

translations.zh: 他故意把门开着，好让猫进来。

senses.definition: an amount taken off the usual price

examples.text: Students get a ten per cent discount at this shop.

translations.zh: 学生在这家店可享受九折优惠。

senses.usageNote: Chinese '打八折' means 20% off in English: 'a 20% discount', not 'an 80% discount'.

senses.definition: a wall made of wood or wire around a field or garden

examples.text: The cat jumped over the fence.

senses.definition: the taste of food or drink

examples.text: What's your favourite ice cream flavour?

translations.zh: 你最喜欢什么口味的冰激凌？

senses.usageNote: British spelling is 'flavour'; American is 'flavor'.

senses.definition: the line far away where the sky seems to meet the land or sea

examples.text: The sun slowly sank below the horizon.

translations.zh: 太阳慢慢落到了地平线以下。

senses.definition: to hurt a person's or an animal's body

examples.text: He injured his knee while playing football.

translations.zh: 他踢足球时膝盖受伤了。

senses.usageNote: People are 'injured' in accidents or sport; things are 'damaged', not injured.

senses.definition: an old, well-known story that may not be true; also a very famous person

examples.text: There is a legend about a dragon living in the lake.

translations.zh: 有个传说讲湖里住着一条龙。

senses.definition: to suddenly feel so afraid that you cannot think clearly

examples.text: Don't panic! We still have ten minutes.

senses.definition: farming; growing crops and keeping animals

examples.text: Many people in the region work in agriculture.

translations.zh: 这个地区许多人从事农业。

senses.definition: not afraid to do difficult or frightening things

examples.text: It was brave of you to sing in front of everyone.

translations.zh: 你敢当着大家的面唱歌，真勇敢。

senses.definition: certain, fixed and not likely to change

examples.text: We don't have a definite date for the trip yet.

translations.zh: 我们还没有确定旅行的日期。

senses.definition: to jump into water with your head and arms going in first

examples.text: She loves diving into the pool.

senses.definition: showing a lot of interest and excitement

examples.text: The fans were very enthusiastic.

senses.usageNote: Use 'enthusiastic about': 'He is enthusiastic about football.'

senses.definition: the state of being alone or keeping your personal information secret

examples.text: Teenagers often want more privacy.

translations.zh: 青少年往往想要更多的隐私。

senses.definition: to say that you are sorry for something you did

examples.text: He apologised for being late.

senses.usageNote: 'Apologise to someone for something'. American English spells it 'apologize'.

senses.definition: a particular type of animal, such as a dog or horse

examples.text: What breed is your dog?

senses.definition: to keep animals so that they produce young

examples.text: My uncle breeds sheep on his farm.

senses.definition: a hard block of baked clay used for building walls

examples.text: Our house is made of red brick.

translations.zh: 我们的房子是用红砖建的。

senses.definition: a quality that makes people like someone or something

examples.text: The little village is full of charm.

senses.definition: to make something easier to understand

examples.text: Could you clarify what you mean?

translations.zh: 你能说清楚你的意思吗？

senses.definition: a person who writes music

examples.text: Mozart was a famous composer.

translations.zh: 莫扎特是一位著名的作曲家。

senses.definition: very pleased and happy

examples.text: We were delighted to hear your good news.

translations.zh: 听到你的好消息我们非常高兴。

senses.definition: wanting very much to do or have something

examples.text: The children were eager to open their presents.

translations.zh: 孩子们迫不及待地想打开礼物。

senses.definition: honestly and directly

examples.text: Frankly, I didn't enjoy the film very much.

translations.zh: 老实说，我不太喜欢这部电影。

senses.definition: a person who is extremely clever or skilled

examples.text: She's a genius at solving puzzles.

senses.definition: the natural home of an animal or plant

examples.text: The forest is the natural habitat of the panda.

translations.zh: 森林是熊猫的自然栖息地。

senses.definition: to give work to a teacher or someone in charge

examples.text: Please hand in your homework by Friday.
examples.cloze: Please {{hand in}} your homework by Friday.

senses.definition: the title of a news story, printed in large letters

examples.text: The headline was about a rescued baby whale.

translations.zh: 头条新闻是关于一头获救的小鲸鱼。

senses.definition: the system that keeps a building warm

examples.text: Can you turn the heating on? It's cold.

translations.zh: 你能把暖气打开吗？好冷。

senses.definition: exactly the same

translations.zh: 完全相同的；一模一样的

examples.text: The two sisters are identical twins.

translations.zh: 这两姐妹是同卵双胞胎。

senses.usageNote: We say 'identical to' or 'identical with' something.

senses.definition: to make someone admire you or respect you

translations.zh: 给……留下深刻印象；使钦佩

examples.text: She impressed everyone with her piano playing.

translations.zh: 她的钢琴演奏让所有人都印象深刻。

senses.usageNote: We say 'I was impressed by/with it', not 'I was impressive'. 'Impressive' describes the thing that impresses you.

senses.definition: very interested in something or wanting to do it

examples.text: My sister is very keen on drawing.

senses.usageNote: We say 'keen on something/doing something' or 'keen to do something'.

senses.definition: connected with or worked by machines

examples.text: The train stopped because of a mechanical problem.

translations.zh: 火车因机械故障停了下来。

senses.definition: an ancient story about gods or heroes; also a common idea that is not true

examples.text: It's a myth that goldfish only remember things for three seconds.

translations.zh: 金鱼只有三秒记忆是一种误传。

senses.definition: something that you need, or the fact of being needed

examples.text: A warm coat is a necessity in winter.

translations.zh: 冬天暖和的外套是必需品。

senses.definition: the ability to wait or deal with problems calmly without getting annoyed

examples.text: Learning to play the guitar takes patience.

senses.usageNote: Don't confuse 'patience' (the quality) with 'patients' (people who see a doctor). They sound the same.

senses.definition: worth a lot of money, or very important to you

examples.text: Time with your family is precious.

translations.zh: 和家人在一起的时光很宝贵。

senses.definition: a set of instructions for cooking a dish

examples.text: My grandmother gave me her recipe for dumplings.

translations.zh: 奶奶把她包饺子的做法给了我。

senses.usageNote: Don't confuse 'recipe' (instructions for cooking) with 'receipt' (proof of payment).

senses.definition: calm and not worried

examples.text: I feel relaxed after a warm bath.

translations.zh: 洗个热水澡后我感觉很放松。

senses.usageNote: 'Relaxed' describes how you feel; 'relaxing' describes what makes you feel that way: 'a relaxing holiday'.

senses.definition: a regular pattern of sounds or movements

examples.text: The children clapped to the rhythm of the song.

translations.zh: 孩子们随着歌曲的节奏拍手。

senses.usageNote: A tricky spelling: r-h-y-t-h-m, with no vowel letters except 'y'.

senses.definition: to cook meat or vegetables in an oven or over a fire

examples.text: We roasted sweet potatoes over the fire.

senses.definition: a situation when there is not enough of something

examples.text: There is a shortage of water in summer.

senses.usageNote: Use 'a shortage of something'.

senses.definition: able to continue for a long time without harming the environment

examples.text: We should use more sustainable energy like solar power.

translations.zh: 我们应该更多地使用太阳能等可持续能源。

senses.definition: to make food or drink go down your throat

examples.text: Chew your food well before you swallow it.

translations.zh: 吃东西要先嚼烂再咽下去。

senses.definition: to lose water through your skin because you are hot or working hard

examples.text: I always sweat a lot when I play basketball.

translations.zh: 我打篮球时总是出很多汗。

senses.definition: the feeling of being sorry for someone who is sad or in trouble

examples.text: I have a lot of sympathy for people who lose their homes in floods.

translations.zh: 我非常同情那些在洪水中失去家园的人。

senses.usageNote: 'Sympathy' is feeling sorry for someone; 'sympathetic' is the adjective, and it does not mean 'nice'.

senses.definition: nervous and worried, not relaxed

examples.text: Everyone felt tense before the results came out.

translations.zh: 结果公布前大家都很紧张。

senses.definition: a verb form that shows the time of an action

examples.text: 'Went' is the past tense of 'go'.

senses.definition: a competition with many games or matches

examples.text: Our team won the table tennis tournament.

translations.zh: 我们队赢得了乒乓球锦标赛。

senses.definition: very great in amount or level

examples.text: The volunteers did a tremendous amount of work.

translations.zh: 志愿者们做了大量的工作。

senses.definition: not treating people in an equal or right way

examples.text: It's unfair that I have to do all the washing-up!

translations.zh: 所有碗都要我洗，这不公平！

senses.definition: to join together to act as a group

examples.text: The whole village united to help the family.

translations.zh: 全村人团结起来帮助这家人。

senses.definition: the place where an event happens

examples.text: The school hall is the venue for the concert.

translations.zh: 学校礼堂是音乐会的举办地点。

senses.definition: happening in many places or among many people

examples.text: The use of mobile phones is widespread among teenagers.

translations.zh: 手机在青少年中非常普及。

senses.definition: animals and plants that live in natural conditions

examples.text: The park is full of wildlife.

translations.zh: 公园里有很多野生动物。

senses.usageNote: 'Wildlife' is uncountable: 'a lot of wildlife', not 'many wildlifes'.

senses.definition: the ability to make good decisions because of knowledge and experience

examples.text: My grandmother is full of wisdom.

senses.definition: to tell people about a product or event so they will buy it or come

examples.text: The shop advertises its sales on the radio.

translations.zh: 这家店在电台上宣传促销活动。

senses.definition: made by people, not natural
