examples.text: The football pitch has artificial grass.

translations.zh: 这个足球场铺的是人造草坪。

senses.definition: making you feel uncomfortable or embarrassed

examples.text: There was an awkward silence after his joke.

translations.zh: 他讲完笑话后是一阵尴尬的沉默。

senses.definition: relaxed and not formal

translations.zh: 随意的；非正式的；休闲的

examples.text: You can wear casual clothes on Friday.

senses.definition: to put things into groups by type

examples.text: We classified the leaves by their shape.

translations.zh: 我们按形状给叶子分类。

senses.definition: one of the very large areas of land on Earth, such as Asia or Africa

examples.text: Asia is the largest continent.

senses.definition: the time or day by which you must finish something

examples.text: The deadline for the science project is next Monday.

translations.zh: 科学作业的截止日期是下周一。

senses.usageNote: We 'meet' a deadline (finish in time) or 'miss' a deadline (finish too late).

senses.definition: something that makes a situation worse or less useful

examples.text: One disadvantage of living here is the noise.

translations.zh: 住在这里的一个缺点是吵。

senses.definition: feeling shy or silly because of something people have seen you do

examples.text: I was embarrassed when I fell over in front of the class.

translations.zh: 我在全班面前摔倒时很尴尬。

senses.usageNote: Spelled with double r and double s. 'Embarrassed' describes how you feel; 'embarrassing' describes the situation.

senses.definition: extremely tired

examples.text: We were exhausted after climbing the mountain.

translations.zh: 爬完山后我们精疲力竭。

senses.usageNote: 'Exhausted' is already very strong, so say 'completely exhausted', not 'very exhausted'.

senses.definition: cloth used for making clothes, curtains and so on

examples.text: This fabric is soft and easy to wash.

translations.zh: 这种布料柔软又容易清洗。

senses.usageNote: 'Fabric' is a false friend for some learners: it means cloth, not a factory.

senses.definition: liking someone or something very much

examples.text: My grandma is very fond of her garden.

translations.zh: 我奶奶非常喜爱她的花园。

senses.usageNote: Always use 'fond of': 'I'm fond of cats.'

senses.definition: the machine parts of a computer, not the programs

examples.text: The problem is with the hardware, not the software.

translations.zh: 问题出在硬件上，而不是软件。

senses.definition: the feeling you have when you need to eat

examples.text: A small snack can stop your hunger until dinner.

translations.zh: 吃点小零食可以让你撑到晚饭。

senses.definition: relaxed and friendly, not following strict rules

examples.text: You can wear informal clothes to the party.

translations.zh: 你可以穿便装去参加聚会。

senses.definition: time when you are not working and can relax

examples.text: What do you like to do in your leisure time?

translations.zh: 你空闲时间喜欢做什么？

senses.definition: sad because you are alone or have no friends

examples.text: She felt lonely when she first moved to a new city.

translations.zh: 她刚搬到新城市时感到很孤独。

senses.usageNote: 'Alone' just means without other people; 'lonely' means you feel sad about it.

senses.definition: at the present time, compared with the past

examples.text: Nowadays most people have a mobile phone.

translations.zh: 如今大多数人都有手机。

senses.definition: a large group of musicians who play different instruments together

examples.text: She plays the violin in the school orchestra.

translations.zh: 她在学校管弦乐队拉小提琴。

senses.definition: a feeling of sadness for someone; also used to say something is disappointing

examples.text: It's a pity you can't come to the party.

translations.zh: 你不能来参加聚会，真可惜。

senses.usageNote: 'What a pity!' and 'It's a pity' mean the same as 'What a shame!'

senses.definition: a statement about what you think will happen

examples.text: My prediction is that our team will win.

senses.definition: a game or problem that you have to think about to solve

examples.text: We did a 500-piece puzzle together.

translations.zh: 我们一起拼了一个500块的拼图。

senses.definition: to make someone confused because they cannot understand something

examples.text: His strange answer puzzled everyone.

translations.zh: 他奇怪的回答让大家很困惑。

senses.definition: wanting very much to be successful

examples.text: He is an ambitious young scientist.

translations.zh: 他是一位雄心勃勃的年轻科学家。

senses.definition: a person whose job is to design buildings

examples.text: The architect showed us a model of the new school.

translations.zh: 建筑师给我们看了新学校的模型。

senses.definition: a high, steep area of rock, often next to the sea

examples.text: Seabirds nest on the cliffs.

senses.definition: to work together with others to do something

examples.text: The two classes cooperated on the garden project.

translations.zh: 两个班合作完成了花园项目。

senses.definition: the act of leaving a place

examples.text: Please check the departure time of your flight.

translations.zh: 请查看你航班的起飞时间。

senses.definition: the sad feeling when something is not as good as you hoped

examples.text: To our disappointment, the zoo was closed.

translations.zh: 令我们失望的是，动物园关门了。

senses.definition: the time when crops are collected, or the crops themselves

examples.text: The farmers had a good harvest this year.

translations.zh: 今年农民们获得了好收成。

senses.definition: having no place to live

examples.text: The shelter helps homeless dogs find new families.

translations.zh: 这家收容所帮助无家可归的狗找到新家。

senses.definition: to stop someone speaking or stop something happening for a short time

examples.text: Please don't interrupt me while I'm talking.

translations.zh: 我说话的时候请不要打断我。

senses.definition: machines as a group, especially large ones

examples.text: The farm uses modern machinery.

translations.zh: 这个农场使用现代化机械。

senses.usageNote: 'Machinery' is uncountable: say 'a piece of machinery', not 'a machinery'.

senses.definition: to make someone want to do something, especially work hard

examples.text: Good teachers motivate their students to learn.

translations.zh: 好老师会激励学生学习。

senses.definition: something that blocks your way or makes it hard to do something

examples.text: Shyness can be an obstacle to making friends.

translations.zh: 害羞可能成为交朋友的障碍。

senses.definition: the process of finding an answer using numbers

examples.text: I made a mistake in my calculation.

senses.definition: to keep people interested and amused

examples.text: The clown entertained the children for an hour.

translations.zh: 小丑逗孩子们玩了一个小时。

senses.definition: causing damage or injury

examples.text: Plastic is harmful to sea animals.

senses.definition: to get involved in something that is not your business, or to stop something working well

examples.text: Don't let video games interfere with your homework.

translations.zh: 别让电子游戏妨碍你做作业。

senses.usageNote: We say 'interfere with' something (stop it working well) and 'interfere in' something (get involved without being asked).

senses.definition: something new that someone has made or designed

examples.text: The telephone was an important invention.

translations.zh: 电话是一项重要的发明。

senses.definition: behaving in a sensible way, like an adult

examples.text: He is very mature for his age.

translations.zh: 以他的年龄来说，他很成熟。

senses.definition: an unfair opinion about a person or group formed without knowing them

examples.text: We should treat people fairly, without prejudice.

translations.zh: 我们应该公平待人，不带偏见。

senses.definition: a small object used to remove pencil marks

examples.text: Can I borrow your rubber?

senses.usageNote: British 'rubber' = American 'eraser'.

senses.definition: a strong material that stretches, used to make tyres, boots, etc.

examples.text: These boots are made of rubber.

senses.definition: to move a spoon round and round in a liquid to mix it

examples.text: Stir the soup so it doesn't burn.

senses.definition: to teach someone, especially at school or university

examples.text: The museum helps to educate visitors about nature.

translations.zh: 这座博物馆帮助游客了解大自然。

senses.definition: to change from solid to liquid because of heat

examples.text: The ice cream melted in the sun.

senses.definition: a ball of air or gas inside a liquid or with a thin skin around it

examples.text: The children were blowing bubbles in the garden.

translations.zh: 孩子们在花园里吹泡泡。

senses.definition: careful to avoid danger or problems

examples.text: She is a cautious driver.

senses.definition: special clothes worn by actors or for a party

examples.text: She wore a pirate costume to the party.

translations.zh: 她穿了一套海盗服装去参加聚会。

senses.usageNote: In British English a 'swimming costume' is what you wear to swim.

senses.definition: the ability to make new things or think of new ideas

examples.text: The art class encourages creativity.

translations.zh: 美术课鼓励发挥创造力。

senses.definition: full of people

examples.text: The train was so crowded that we had to stand.

translations.zh: 火车太挤了，我们只好站着。

senses.definition: a box in a piece of furniture that you pull out to put things in

examples.text: My socks are in the top drawer.

translations.zh: 我的袜子在最上面的抽屉里。

senses.definition: a sudden shaking of the ground

examples.text: The earthquake shook the buildings for a few seconds.

translations.zh: 地震让建筑物摇晃了几秒钟。

senses.definition: making you feel shy or silly

examples.text: It was embarrassing to forget my lines in the play.

translations.zh: 在话剧里忘词真是太尴尬了。

senses.definition: the money you pay to travel by bus, train or plane

examples.text: The bus fare is cheaper for children.

translations.zh: 儿童的公交车费更便宜。

senses.usageNote: 'Fare' is for travel; 'fee' is for services like lessons or entry.

senses.definition: to say that someone must not do something

examples.text: The library forbids eating near the books.

translations.zh: 图书馆禁止在书旁边吃东西。

examples.text: Swimming is forbidden in this lake.
examples.cloze: Swimming is {{forbidden}} in this lake.

senses.definition: the thick soft hair that covers some animals

examples.text: Our cat has soft white fur.

translations.zh: 我们的猫有柔软的白毛。

senses.definition: extremely angry

examples.text: Dad was furious when the dog ate his sandwich.

translations.zh: 狗吃了爸爸的三明治，他气坏了。

senses.definition: a quick look at something that you see only for a moment

examples.text: We caught a glimpse of a deer in the forest.

translations.zh: 我们在森林里瞥见了一只鹿。

senses.definition: the force that makes things fall to the ground

examples.text: Gravity is weaker on the moon than on Earth.

translations.zh: 月球上的重力比地球上弱。

senses.definition: food and other things for the home that you buy in a shop

examples.text: Can you help me carry the groceries?

translations.zh: 你能帮我拿一下买的东西吗？

senses.usageNote: Usually plural: 'buy the groceries'.

senses.definition: to put your arms around someone to show you care about them

examples.text: Grandma hugged me when I arrived.

translations.zh: 我到的时候奶奶拥抱了我。

senses.definition: to keep someone or something separate from others

examples.text: The village was isolated by the heavy snow.

translations.zh: 大雪让这个村子与外界隔绝了。

senses.definition: recently; in the last few days or weeks

examples.text: Have you seen any good films lately?

translations.zh: 你最近看过什么好电影吗？

senses.usageNote: 'Lately' means 'recently', not 'late'. It is often used with the present perfect: 'I've been busy lately'.

senses.definition: to let liquid or gas get out through a small hole

examples.text: The roof leaks every time it rains.

senses.definition: always supporting and staying with a person, group or idea

examples.text: Dogs are loyal to their owners.

senses.definition: to fail to notice something; also to have a view of a place from above

examples.text: Our room overlooks the sea.

translations.zh: 我们的房间可以俯瞰大海。

examples.text: It's easy to overlook small spelling mistakes.

translations.zh: 小的拼写错误很容易被忽略。

senses.usageNote: 'Overlook' does not mean 'look over' (check quickly).

senses.definition: letting things happen without taking action

examples.text: Don't be passive in class – ask questions!

senses.definition: to tell someone about a fact or show them something

examples.text: Can you point out any mistakes in my letter?

translations.zh: 你能指出我信里的错误吗？

examples.cloze: Can you {{point out}} any mistakes in my letter?

senses.definition: the state of being liked by many people

examples.text: The popularity of cycling is growing.

translations.zh: 骑自行车越来越受欢迎了。

senses.definition: not polite

examples.text: It's rude to talk while someone else is speaking.

translations.zh: 别人说话时插嘴是不礼貌的。

senses.definition: showing good judgement; practical

examples.text: It's sensible to take an umbrella today.

senses.usageNote: False friend: 'sensible' means 'wise', while 'sensitive' means easily upset or affected.

senses.definition: your name written in your own special way

examples.text: Please put your signature at the bottom of the form.

senses.usageNote: 'Sign' is the verb: 'sign your name'. The noun is 'signature', not 'sign'.

senses.definition: to not do something you usually do or should do

examples.text: Don't skip breakfast — it's important.

translations.zh: 别不吃早饭，早饭很重要。

senses.definition: to move forward with small jumps

examples.text: The little girl skipped down the path.

translations.zh: 小女孩蹦蹦跳跳地沿着小路走去。

senses.definition: to make something less good or enjoyable

examples.text: Don't spoil the film by telling me the ending!

translations.zh: 别告诉我结局，那会毁了这部电影！

senses.definition: to give a child everything they want, so they behave badly

examples.text: His grandparents spoil him with sweets.

translations.zh: 他的爷爷奶奶用糖果宠坏了他。

senses.definition: rising or falling very quickly, not gradual

examples.text: The path up the hill is very steep.

senses.definition: feeling that something is wrong or that someone is not honest

examples.text: The dog was suspicious of the stranger at the door.

translations.zh: 狗对门口的陌生人很警惕。

senses.usageNote: 'Suspicious of someone' = you don't trust them; 'a suspicious noise' = a noise that seems wrong.

senses.definition: done carefully and completely, including every detail

examples.text: The doctor gave him a thorough check.

translations.zh: 医生给他做了一次全面检查。

senses.usageNote: Don't confuse 'thorough' /ˈθʌrə/ with 'through' /θruː/ or 'though' /ðəʊ/.

senses.definition: harmful to people, animals or plants

examples.text: Some plants are toxic to cats.

senses.definition: in a state like sleep because of an injury or illness

examples.text: He fainted and was unconscious for a minute.

translations.zh: 他晕倒了，失去知觉约一分钟。

senses.definition: under or below something, often hidden by it

examples.text: I found my sock underneath the bed.

translations.zh: 我在床底下找到了我的袜子。

senses.definition: to change something for a better or newer version

examples.text: We upgraded our computer last month.

translations.zh: 我们上个月升级了电脑。

senses.definition: not clear or not detailed

examples.text: I only have a vague memory of my first birthday.

translations.zh: 我对自己的一岁生日只有模糊的记忆。

senses.definition: done because you want to, not because you must; done without being paid

examples.text: She does voluntary work at the animal shelter.

translations.zh: 她在动物收容所做义工。

senses.definition: easily damaged or broken, and needing care

examples.text: Be careful with those delicate glass cups.

translations.zh: 小心那些易碎的玻璃杯。

senses.definition: to not like someone or something

examples.text: Many children dislike eating vegetables.

translations.zh: 很多孩子不喜欢吃蔬菜。

senses.definition: to take in a liquid, heat or information

examples.text: The towel absorbed all the water on the floor.

translations.zh: 毛巾把地上的水全吸干了。

senses.definition: something you buy for much less than its usual price

examples.text: These shoes were a real bargain at ten pounds.

translations.zh: 这双鞋才十英镑，真划算。

senses.definition: the state of being completely sure

examples.text: Nobody can say with certainty what will happen.

translations.zh: 没人能确定会发生什么。

senses.definition: very pleasant and attractive

examples.text: We stayed in a charming little cottage.

translations.zh: 我们住在一间迷人的小屋里。

senses.definition: to break the rules to win or do well

examples.text: It's wrong to cheat in a test.

senses.definition: difficult to understand

examples.text: The instructions were really confusing.

translations.zh: 说明书真让人摸不着头脑。

senses.definition: the time early in the morning when light first appears

examples.text: We got up at dawn to watch the sunrise.

translations.zh: 我们黎明时起床去看日出。

senses.definition: to let water or liquid flow away from something

examples.text: Drain the pasta and add the sauce.

translations.zh: 把意面沥干，然后加酱汁。

senses.definition: the joint in the middle of your arm where it bends

examples.text: Don't put your elbows on the table.

translations.zh: 别把胳膊肘放在桌子上。

senses.definition: attractive and stylish in a graceful way

examples.text: She wore an elegant blue dress.

translations.zh: 她穿了一条优雅的蓝色连衣裙。

senses.definition: lucky

examples.text: We were fortunate to have such good weather.

translations.zh: 我们很幸运，遇上了这么好的天气。

senses.definition: a picture with lines or bars that shows how numbers change

examples.text: The graph shows the temperature for each month.

translations.zh: 这张图表显示了每个月的气温。

senses.definition: the quality of always telling the truth

examples.text: Honesty is very important in a friendship.

translations.zh: 诚实在友谊中非常重要。

senses.definition: to talk or do things with other people, or to affect each other

examples.text: The children interact well with each other at playtime.

translations.zh: 孩子们在游戏时间里相处融洽。

senses.definition: in the same way; also

examples.text: He sat down, and his friends did likewise.

translations.zh: 他坐了下来，他的朋友们也坐下了。

senses.definition: very unhappy, or making you feel unhappy

examples.text: I felt miserable when I had a cold.
It was a cold, miserable day.

translations.zh: 那是寒冷又阴沉的一天。

senses.definition: hoping or believing that good things will happen

examples.text: I'm optimistic that we will win the next game.

translations.zh: 我很乐观，觉得我们下一场会赢。

senses.definition: to make the sound of a word or letter

examples.text: How do you pronounce this word?

senses.definition: very sad and without hope, often for a long time

examples.text: He felt a bit depressed after the long winter.

translations.zh: 漫长的冬天过后他感到有点消沉。

senses.definition: to take someone's attention away from what they are doing

examples.text: Don't distract me while I'm doing my homework.

translations.zh: 我做作业的时候别让我分心。

senses.definition: one of the soft, light things that cover a bird's body

examples.text: The parrot has bright green feathers.

translations.zh: 这只鹦鹉有鲜绿色的羽毛。

senses.definition: a glass building where plants are grown

examples.text: Grandpa grows tomatoes in his greenhouse.

translations.zh: 爷爷在他的温室里种西红柿。

senses.definition: impossible to see

examples.text: Air is invisible, but we can feel the wind.

translations.zh: 空气是看不见的，但我们能感觉到风。

senses.definition: based on ideas rather than real things you can see or touch

examples.text: Love and fairness are abstract ideas.

translations.zh: 爱和公平是抽象的概念。

senses.definition: doing an activity for fun, not as a paid job

examples.text: He plays for an amateur football team.

translations.zh: 他在一支业余足球队踢球。

senses.definition: made from milk

examples.text: Cheese and yoghurt are dairy products.

translations.zh: 奶酪和酸奶都是乳制品。

senses.usageNote: Don't confuse 'dairy' (/ˈdeəri/, milk products) with 'diary' (/ˈdaɪəri/, a daily notebook).

senses.definition: to make something look nicer by adding pretty things to it

examples.text: We decorated the classroom with balloons.

translations.zh: 我们用气球装饰了教室。

senses.definition: not interesting or exciting; not bright

examples.text: The film was so dull that I fell asleep.

translations.zh: 电影太无聊了，我都睡着了。

senses.definition: a long journey to explore a place

examples.text: They went on an expedition to the South Pole.

translations.zh: 他们去南极进行了一次探险。

senses.definition: believing that something good will happen

examples.text: We are hopeful that the weather will be sunny.

senses.definition: full of energy and excitement

examples.text: The market is always lively on Saturdays.

translations.zh: 周六的集市总是很热闹。

senses.usageNote: 'Lively' is an adjective, not an adverb, even though it ends in -ly.

senses.definition: words or ideas that are silly or not true

examples.text: That's nonsense! Cats can't talk.

senses.definition: the food you eat and how it affects your health

examples.text: Good nutrition helps children grow strong.

translations.zh: 良好的营养有助于孩子健康成长。

senses.definition: a day that is exactly a year or more after an important event

examples.text: The school is celebrating its fiftieth anniversary.

translations.zh: 学校正在庆祝五十周年校庆。

senses.definition: to talk too proudly about yourself

examples.text: He's always boasting about his new trainers.

translations.zh: 他总是炫耀他的新运动鞋。

senses.definition: a simple drawing that shows how something works or what it looks like

examples.text: The diagram shows the parts of a flower.

translations.zh: 这张图展示了花的各个部分。

senses.definition: to give money or things to help people or an organisation

examples.text: We donated our old toys to the children's hospital.

translations.zh: 我们把旧玩具捐给了儿童医院。

senses.definition: the shape of a very old animal or plant kept in rock

examples.text: We found a fossil of a shell on the beach.

translations.zh: 我们在海滩上发现了一块贝壳化石。

senses.definition: to make someone feel afraid

examples.text: The loud noise frightened the birds.

translations.zh: 巨大的声响吓跑了鸟儿。

senses.definition: a thin white layer of ice that forms on cold surfaces

examples.text: There was frost on the car windows this morning.

translations.zh: 今天早上车窗上结了霜。

senses.definition: useful and easy to use; near and easy to reach

examples.text: A torch is handy if the lights go out.

senses.definition: to invent a story or excuse; also to become friends again after an argument

examples.text: Let's make up a story about a flying cat.

translations.zh: 我们来编一个关于会飞的猫的故事吧。

examples.cloze: Let's {{make up}} a story about a flying cat.

senses.definition: to not give enough care or attention to someone or something

examples.text: The garden was neglected and full of weeds.

translations.zh: 花园无人打理，长满了杂草。

senses.definition: to decide to do something later than planned

examples.text: Don't put off your homework until Sunday night.

translations.zh: 别把作业拖到周日晚上。

examples.cloze: Don't {{put off}} your homework until Sunday night.

senses.definition: a piece of paper that shows you have paid for something

examples.text: Keep the receipt in case you want to return it.

translations.zh: 保留好收据，以防你想退货。

senses.usageNote: The 'p' in 'receipt' is silent: /rɪˈsiːt/.

senses.definition: a story that people talk about which may not be true

examples.text: There's a rumour that our school trip is cancelled.

translations.zh: 有传言说我们学校的旅行取消了。

senses.definition: money given to a student to help pay for their studies

examples.text: He won a scholarship to study in London.

translations.zh: 他获得了去伦敦留学的奖学金。

senses.definition: without other people knowing

examples.text: We secretly planned a party for Dad's birthday.

translations.zh: 我们偷偷为爸爸的生日策划了一个派对。

senses.definition: not deep

examples.text: Young children should swim in the shallow end.

translations.zh: 小孩子应该在浅水区游泳。

senses.definition: to let a liquid fall out of a container by accident

examples.text: Oh no, I spilled juice on my homework!

translations.zh: 糟糕，我把果汁洒在作业上了！

senses.definition: an area where people live on the edge of a city

examples.text: They moved from the city centre to a quiet suburb.

translations.zh: 他们从市中心搬到了一个安静的郊区。

senses.usageNote: We usually say 'in the suburbs' (plural) to mean the outer parts of a city in general.

senses.definition: to give something to someone and get something from them

examples.text: Can we swap seats? I want to sit by the window.

translations.zh: 我们能换个座位吗？我想坐靠窗的位置。

senses.definition: a tendency to become angry quickly

examples.text: He has a bad temper when he's tired.

senses.usageNote: 'Lose your temper' means suddenly become angry.

senses.definition: to accept something unpleasant without complaining

examples.text: Some plants can tolerate very cold weather.

translations.zh: 有些植物能耐受非常寒冷的天气。

senses.definition: a teacher who teaches one student or a small group

examples.text: He has a maths tutor on Saturdays.

senses.definition: not knowing about something

examples.text: I was unaware that the shop had closed.

translations.zh: 我不知道那家店已经关门了。

senses.usageNote: Use 'unaware of something' or 'unaware that...'.

senses.definition: not nice or enjoyable

examples.text: There was an unpleasant smell in the fridge.

translations.zh: 冰箱里有一股难闻的气味。

senses.definition: not useful or not working

examples.text: This old map is useless now.

translations.zh: 这张旧地图现在没用了。

senses.definition: to clean a floor with a machine that sucks up dirt

examples.text: I vacuum my bedroom every Saturday.

translations.zh: 我每周六用吸尘器打扫卧室。

senses.usageNote: The machine is a 'vacuum cleaner'. In British English people also say 'hoover'.

senses.definition: very bright or very clear, producing strong pictures in your mind

examples.text: I had a very vivid dream last night.

translations.zh: 我昨晚做了一个非常清晰的梦。

senses.definition: all the words that a person knows or that are used in a language

examples.text: Reading every day helps to build your vocabulary.

translations.zh: 每天阅读有助于扩大词汇量。

senses.usageNote: 'Vocabulary' is usually uncountable: say 'learn new vocabulary' or 'learn new words', not 'learn new vocabularies'.

senses.definition: the part of your body between your hand and your arm

examples.text: She wears a watch on her left wrist.

translations.zh: 她左手腕上戴着一块手表。

senses.definition: to shout loudly

examples.text: The fans yelled with excitement when their team scored.

translations.zh: 球队进球时，球迷们兴奋地大喊。

senses.definition: the way people from a certain place or country say words

examples.text: He speaks English with a Scottish accent.

translations.zh: 他说英语带苏格兰口音。

senses.definition: to mix things together well

examples.text: Blend the bananas and milk to make a smoothie.

translations.zh: 把香蕉和牛奶搅拌在一起做成奶昔。

senses.definition: to remove words, pictures or files, especially from a computer

examples.text: I accidentally deleted all my holiday photos.

translations.zh: 我不小心删掉了所有的假期照片。

senses.definition: easily broken or damaged

examples.text: The box says 'Fragile – handle with care'.

translations.zh: 箱子上写着“易碎——小心轻放”。

examples.cloze: The box says '{{Fragile}} – handle with care'.

senses.definition: worried or excited behaviour about something that is not important

examples.text: Don't make a fuss about a little scratch.

translations.zh: 别为一点小擦伤大惊小怪。

senses.definition: very bad at something; with no chance of success

examples.text: I'm hopeless at drawing.

senses.usageNote: Use 'hopeless at' for skills: 'hopeless at maths'.

senses.definition: to look at something carefully to check it

examples.text: The mechanic inspected the car's brakes.

translations.zh: 技师检查了汽车的刹车。

senses.definition: tidy and carefully arranged

examples.text: Your handwriting is very neat.

senses.definition: very similar

examples.text: The two sisters look very alike.

senses.usageNote: 'Alike' is not used before a noun: say 'They are alike', not 'alike sisters'.

senses.definition: towards the direction behind you

examples.text: Can you say the alphabet backwards?

senses.definition: to hit something by accident

examples.text: I bumped my head on the door.

senses.usageNote: 'Bump into someone' also means to meet them by chance.

senses.definition: extremely unpleasant

examples.text: This milk smells disgusting.

senses.definition: unusual and exciting because it comes from a faraway country

examples.text: The market sells exotic fruits like mangosteen.

translations.zh: 这个市场出售山竹等异国水果。

senses.definition: the study of countries, mountains, rivers, weather and people

examples.text: In geography we learnt about volcanoes.

translations.zh: 在地理课上我们学习了火山。

senses.definition: not thinking that you are better than other people

examples.text: Even after winning, she stayed humble.

translations.zh: 即使赢了，她依然很谦逊。

senses.definition: unhappy because someone has something you want

examples.text: He was jealous of his brother's new bike.

translations.zh: 他嫉妒哥哥的新自行车。

senses.usageNote: We say 'jealous of' someone or something, not 'jealous about' or 'jealous with'.

senses.definition: a picture, film or notice that tries to make people buy something

examples.text: I saw an advertisement for a new phone.

translations.zh: 我看到一则新手机的广告。

senses.usageNote: In everyday speech people often say 'advert' or 'ad'. 'Advertising' is the uncountable word for the business.

senses.definition: the feeling that you want to eat

examples.text: Swimming always gives me a big appetite.

senses.definition: to leave a place, especially to start a journey

examples.text: The bus departs from the station at nine.

translations.zh: 公共汽车九点从车站出发。

senses.definition: popular at a particular time

examples.text: She always wears fashionable clothes.

translations.zh: 她总是穿着时髦的衣服。

senses.definition: very beautiful or pleasant

examples.text: What a gorgeous sunny day!

senses.definition: talk about other people's private lives, which may not be true

examples.text: Don't listen to gossip about your classmates.

senses.definition: sensible and based on clear reasons

examples.text: There must be a logical explanation for the noise.

translations.zh: 这个声音一定有合理的解释。

senses.definition: a storm with very strong winds

examples.text: The hurricane knocked down many trees.

senses.definition: a little angry

examples.text: Mum was annoyed that I was late again.

translations.zh: 我又迟到了，妈妈很生气。

senses.usageNote: Say 'annoyed with someone' and 'annoyed about something'.

senses.definition: a sign shaped like a line with a point, showing a direction

examples.text: Follow the arrows to the exit.

senses.definition: feeling sorry and bad about something you did

examples.text: He felt ashamed of being rude to his friend.

translations.zh: 他为对朋友无礼感到羞愧。

senses.usageNote: 'Ashamed' is about doing something wrong; 'embarrassed' is about feeling silly in front of others.

senses.definition: to hit a surface and move quickly away again

examples.text: The ball bounced over the wall.

senses.definition: a round open container with a handle, used for carrying water

examples.text: We filled a bucket with sand on the beach.

translations.zh: 我们在海滩上装了一桶沙子。

senses.definition: empty, with no people

examples.text: The beach was deserted early in the morning.

senses.definition: rings, necklaces and other objects worn for decoration

examples.text: She keeps her jewellery in a small wooden box.

translations.zh: 她把首饰放在一个小木盒里。

senses.usageNote: 'Jewellery' is uncountable: say 'a piece of jewellery', not 'a jewellery' or 'jewelleries'.

senses.definition: to move or learn at the same speed as someone else

examples.text: I had to run to keep up with my dad.

translations.zh: 我得跑步才能跟上爸爸。

examples.cloze: I had to run to {{keep up with}} my dad.

senses.definition: an arrangement to keep a table, room or seat for you

examples.text: I made a reservation for four people at seven o'clock.

translations.zh: 我预订了七点钟四个人的位子。

senses.definition: possibly dangerous or likely to go wrong

examples.text: Climbing without a rope is too risky.

translations.zh: 不用绳子攀岩太危险了。

senses.definition: to try to make people admire what you have or can do

examples.text: He likes to show off his new trainers.

translations.zh: 他喜欢炫耀他的新运动鞋。

examples.cloze: He likes to {{show off}} his new trainers.

senses.definition: to make water or another liquid fly through the air in drops

examples.text: The children splashed each other in the pool.

translations.zh: 孩子们在泳池里互相泼水。

senses.definition: to watch over people or an activity to make sure it is done correctly and safely

examples.text: Two teachers supervise the children at lunchtime.

translations.zh: 午饭时间有两位老师看管孩子们。

senses.definition: very good; excellent

examples.text: You did a terrific job on your project!

senses.usageNote: False friend: 'terrific' means 'great', but 'terrible' means 'very bad'.

senses.definition: clear enough that you can see through it

examples.text: Put your pencils in a transparent bag for the exam.

translations.zh: 考试时把铅笔放在透明袋里。

senses.definition: a cup or other prize given to the winner of a competition

examples.text: The captain lifted the trophy above her head.

translations.zh: 队长把奖杯高高举过头顶。

senses.definition: to open something using a key or code

examples.text: Use your fingerprint to unlock the phone.

senses.definition: a person who does not eat meat or fish

examples.text: My sister has been a vegetarian for two years.

senses.definition: useful or enjoyable enough to spend time or effort on

examples.text: Learning a musical instrument is a worthwhile hobby.

translations.zh: 学一种乐器是很有意义的爱好。

senses.definition: a book about someone's life, written by another person

examples.text: I'm reading a biography of a famous scientist.

translations.zh: 我在读一位著名科学家的传记。

senses.usageNote: If the person writes about their own life, it is an 'autobiography'.

senses.definition: to make something sound bigger, better or worse than it really is

examples.text: He exaggerated when he said the fish was two metres long.

translations.zh: 他说那条鱼有两米长，那是夸大了。

senses.definition: a person who asks formally for a job, a place at a school, etc.

examples.text: There were over a hundred applicants for the job.

translations.zh: 这份工作有一百多个申请人。

senses.definition: the part of a vehicle that makes it slow down or stop

examples.text: Check the brakes on your bike before you ride.

translations.zh: 骑车前检查一下自行车的刹车。

senses.definition: very beautiful, large or impressive

examples.text: The castle has a magnificent garden.

translations.zh: 这座城堡有一个宏伟的花园。

senses.definition: to change an event to a later time

examples.text: The match was postponed because of the rain.

senses.definition: to make someone upset or annoyed by being rude

examples.text: I'm sorry if my joke offended you.

translations.zh: 如果我的玩笑冒犯了你，我很抱歉。

senses.definition: very surprised

examples.text: I was amazed by how fast she could run.

translations.zh: 她跑得那么快，我很惊讶。

senses.usageNote: People feel 'amazed'; the thing that causes the feeling is 'amazing'.

senses.definition: to make someone a little angry

examples.text: It annoys me when people talk during films.

translations.zh: 看电影时有人说话会让我很烦。

senses.definition: kind and helpful to other people

examples.text: She is a very caring older sister.

translations.zh: 她是一个非常体贴的姐姐。

senses.definition: something nice you say to praise someone

examples.text: She paid me a compliment on my new haircut.

senses.usageNote: Don't confuse 'compliment' (praise) with 'complement' (something that goes well with another thing).

senses.definition: able to speak a language easily and well

examples.text: After two years, she became fluent in English.

translations.zh: 两年后，她的英语变得很流利。

senses.usageNote: Say 'fluent in English' or 'speak fluent English', not 'fluent English speaking'.

senses.definition: the quality of being friendly, helpful and caring

examples.text: Thank you for your kindness when I was ill.

translations.zh: 谢谢你在我生病时对我的关心。

senses.definition: wrong in what you think or believe

examples.text: If I'm not mistaken, the shop closes at six.

translations.zh: 如果我没弄错的话，商店六点关门。

senses.definition: to start doing or talking about something new

translations.zh: 继续前进；转向新的事情

examples.text: Let's move on to the next question.

translations.zh: 我们接着看下一个问题吧。

examples.cloze: Let's {{move on}} to the next question.

senses.definition: to turn round a central point

examples.text: The Earth rotates once every 24 hours.

senses.definition: not often

examples.text: We seldom eat out during the week.

translations.zh: 我们平时很少在外面吃饭。

senses.definition: a dirty mark that is hard to remove

examples.text: There's a coffee stain on my shirt.

translations.zh: 我的衬衫上有块咖啡渍。

senses.definition: excellent; of very high quality

examples.text: The view from the top was superb.

translations.zh: 从山顶看到的景色棒极了。

senses.definition: the place and conditions around you

examples.text: It takes time for a new pet to get used to its surroundings.

translations.zh: 新宠物需要时间来适应周围的环境。

senses.definition: very happy and excited

translations.zh: 非常兴奋的；极为高兴的

examples.text: She was thrilled to win first prize.

translations.zh: 获得一等奖让她激动不已。

senses.definition: not good for your health, or not in good health

examples.text: Eating too many sweets is unhealthy.

translations.zh: 吃太多糖果对健康不好。

senses.definition: not honest; willing to lie or cheat

examples.text: It's dishonest to copy someone else's homework.

translations.zh: 抄别人的作业是不诚实的。

senses.definition: a famous building or place that is easy to recognise

examples.text: Big Ben is one of London's best-known landmarks.

translations.zh: 大本钟是伦敦最著名的地标之一。

senses.definition: clothes and sheets that need washing or have just been washed

translations.zh: 要洗的衣物；洗好的衣物

examples.text: I do the laundry every Saturday.

senses.definition: to do what a person, rule or law tells you to do

examples.text: Drivers must obey the traffic lights.

translations.zh: 司机必须遵守交通信号灯。

senses.definition: a person in your family who lived a long time before you

examples.text: My ancestors were farmers in the north.

translations.zh: 我的祖先是北方的农民。

senses.definition: the bags and cases you take on a journey

examples.text: Please collect your baggage from belt four.

translations.zh: 请到四号转盘领取行李。

senses.usageNote: 'Baggage' is uncountable: say 'a piece of baggage' or 'two bags', not 'two baggages'.

senses.definition: happy and positive

examples.text: Our neighbour is always cheerful in the mornings.

translations.zh: 我们的邻居每天早上总是很开心。

senses.definition: when two things happen together by chance in a surprising way

examples.text: What a coincidence! We have the same birthday.

translations.zh: 真巧！我们生日是同一天。

senses.definition: to tell someone you are pleased about their success or good news

examples.text: Everyone congratulated her on passing the exam.

translations.zh: 大家都祝贺她通过了考试。

senses.usageNote: Say 'congratulate someone on something', not 'for'. The noun 'congratulations' always ends in -s.

senses.definition: no longer existing, because all of that kind of animal or plant has died

examples.text: Dinosaurs became extinct millions of years ago.

translations.zh: 恐龙在数百万年前就灭绝了。

senses.definition: to close or fix something so it will not open or move

examples.text: Please fasten your seat belt.

senses.usageNote: The 't' is silent: /ˈfɑːsn/.

senses.definition: easily annoyed when you have to wait

examples.text: The children were getting impatient for the film to start.

translations.zh: 孩子们等着电影开始，越来越不耐烦了。

senses.definition: easy to see or notice

examples.text: There's been a noticeable improvement in the weather.

senses.definition: by chance, without planning to

examples.text: I accidentally deleted my homework file.

translations.zh: 我不小心删掉了作业文件。

senses.definition: an arrangement to have a seat, room or table at a certain time

examples.text: I made a booking for four people at seven.

translations.zh: 我预订了七点四个人的位子。

senses.definition: not going straight to a place or not saying something clearly

examples.text: We took an indirect route to avoid the traffic.

translations.zh: 我们绕了路以避开交通拥堵。

senses.definition: to try to find out the facts about a problem

examples.text: The head teacher promised to look into the problem.

translations.zh: 校长答应调查这个问题。

examples.cloze: The head teacher promised to {{look into}} the problem.

senses.definition: a list of questions that many people answer to give information

examples.text: Please fill in this short questionnaire about the course.

translations.zh: 请填写这份关于课程的简短问卷。

senses.definition: to treat used things so that they can be used again

examples.text: We recycle all our plastic bottles.

translations.zh: 我们把所有塑料瓶都回收利用。

senses.definition: covered with something that sticks to things

examples.text: My hands are sticky from the honey.

translations.zh: 我的手沾了蜂蜜，黏糊糊的。

senses.definition: a long, narrow line of colour

examples.text: A zebra has black and white stripes.

translations.zh: 斑马身上有黑白相间的条纹。

senses.definition: kind and always thinking about what other people need

examples.text: It was very thoughtful of you to bring me soup.

translations.zh: 你给我带汤来，真是太体贴了。

senses.definition: making you feel tired

examples.text: It was a long and tiring journey.

translations.zh: 那是一段漫长而累人的旅程。

senses.usageNote: 'Tiring' describes the activity; 'tired' describes how you feel: 'The trip was tiring, so I was tired.'

senses.definition: difficult and needing care

examples.text: The last question on the test was tricky.

translations.zh: 试卷上的最后一道题很难。

senses.definition: a way of thinking about something; an opinion

examples.text: Try to see the problem from her viewpoint.

translations.zh: 试着从她的角度看这个问题。

senses.definition: a long journey, especially by sea or in space

examples.text: The ship's voyage across the ocean took three weeks.

translations.zh: 这艘船横渡大洋用了三周时间。

senses.definition: to shut and open your eyes very quickly

examples.text: She blinked in the bright sunlight.

translations.zh: 她在强烈的阳光下眨了眨眼。

senses.definition: to make someone annoyed, or to make part of the body sore

examples.text: The loud music from next door irritated him.

translations.zh: 隔壁的吵闹音乐让他很烦。

senses.definition: paper, cans and other rubbish left on the ground in a public place

examples.text: Please put your litter in the bin.

senses.usageNote: 'Litter' is uncountable: say 'a piece of litter', not 'a litter'.

senses.definition: heavier than is healthy or allowed

examples.text: My suitcase was overweight, so I took some things out.

translations.zh: 我的行李箱超重了，所以我拿出来一些东西。

senses.definition: funny and making you smile

examples.text: He told us an amusing story about his dog.

translations.zh: 他给我们讲了一个关于他的狗的趣事。

senses.definition: the sound of people clapping to show they enjoyed something

examples.text: There was loud applause at the end of the show.

translations.zh: 演出结束时响起了热烈的掌声。

senses.usageNote: 'Applause' is uncountable: say 'a round of applause', not 'an applause'.

senses.definition: a style of cooking from a certain country or area

examples.text: I love trying different cuisines when I travel.

translations.zh: 旅行时我喜欢尝试不同的菜肴。

senses.definition: to disappoint someone by not doing what they hoped

examples.text: I felt let down when my friend didn't come.

translations.zh: 朋友没来，我感到很失望。

examples.cloze: I felt {{let down}} when my friend didn't come.

senses.usageNote: With an object, the object usually goes in the middle: 'Don't let me down.'

senses.definition: an angry argument between people who know each other

examples.text: The twins had a quarrel about the remote control.

translations.zh: 双胞胎为了遥控器吵了一架。

senses.usageNote: The verb is 'quarrel' with someone 'about' something. Its past tense is 'quarrelled' in British English.

senses.definition: honest and meaning what you say

examples.text: Please accept my sincere thanks.

senses.definition: having a sharp taste like a lemon

examples.text: These green apples are very sour.

senses.definition: not willing to change your opinion or behaviour

examples.text: My little brother is too stubborn to say sorry.

translations.zh: 我弟弟太倔了，不肯道歉。

senses.definition: a job that is available, or a free room in a hotel

examples.text: The café has a vacancy for a waiter.

translations.zh: 这家咖啡馆有一个服务员职位空缺。

senses.definition: the amount of work a person has to do

examples.text: Students have a heavy workload before exams.

translations.zh: 考试前学生的学习任务很重。

senses.definition: to go down and rest on your knees

examples.text: She had to kneel on the floor to find her earring.

translations.zh: 她不得不跪在地上找她的耳环。

senses.definition: feeling that everything is spinning and you might fall

examples.text: I felt dizzy after the roller coaster ride.

translations.zh: 坐完过山车后我感到头晕。

senses.definition: to copy the way someone speaks, moves or behaves

examples.text: Parrots can imitate human voices.

senses.definition: hot and wet in a way that feels uncomfortable

examples.text: Summers in Guangzhou are hot and humid.

translations.zh: 广州的夏天又热又潮湿。

senses.definition: a machine used in the home, such as a fridge or washing machine

examples.text: Turn off electrical appliances when you go out.

translations.zh: 出门时要关掉家用电器。

senses.definition: not paying enough attention, so you make mistakes

examples.text: I made some careless mistakes in the test.

translations.zh: 我在考试中犯了一些粗心的错误。

senses.definition: to travel the same way to and from work or school every day

examples.text: My dad commutes to the city by train.

translations.zh: 我爸爸坐火车往返城里上班。

senses.definition: the way a word is said

examples.text: Her English pronunciation is very clear.

translations.zh: 她的英语发音非常清晰。

senses.usageNote: Note the spelling: 'pronunciation', not 'pronounciation'.

senses.definition: that you must do because of a rule

translations.zh: 必须做的；强制的；必修的

examples.text: Maths is a compulsory subject at our school.

translations.zh: 数学是我们学校的必修课。

senses.definition: to go past a moving vehicle or person because you are faster

examples.text: It's dangerous to overtake on a bend.

senses.definition: becoming ill when you eat, touch or breathe in a certain thing

examples.text: My sister is allergic to peanuts.

senses.usageNote: Say 'allergic to something', not 'allergic with' or 'allergic of'.

senses.definition: a piece of printed paper that gives information about something

examples.text: They gave out leaflets about the summer fair.

translations.zh: 他们分发了关于夏季集市的传单。

senses.definition: the quality of being brave

examples.text: The firefighter got a medal for her bravery.

translations.zh: 这位消防员因勇敢获得了奖章。

senses.definition: arriving or doing something at the right time, not late

examples.text: Please be punctual for the meeting tomorrow.

senses.definition: kind and thinking about other people's feelings

examples.text: It was considerate of you to keep the noise down.

translations.zh: 你把声音放小，真是体贴。
